title: Method for controlling firearm safety based on Internet of things and smart firearm
abstract: An embodiment of the invention discloses a method for controlling firearm safety based on Internet of things (IOT) and a smart firearm. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information at a present moment by the smart firearm; acquiring biological feature information of a user by a biological feature acquisition module arranged on a surface of the smart firearm after determining that the smart firearm is located in an authorized region according to the position information; and unlocking the smart firearm when determining that the biological feature information is matched with preset biological feature information. In the embodiment of the invention, after the smart firearm is located in the authorized region, the user can unlock the smart firearm by inputting fingerprint information, a use range of the smart firearm can be limited and the authorized users can be allowed to use the smart firearm. In addition, after the smart firearm leaves the authorized region,the alarm can be given timely and the position information of the smart firearm can be reported in real time.
lim: Alert destination and central/national database are unspecified. No use-purpose classification or danger-based unlocking.
reason: Fingerprint matching and authorized-region checks jointly gate firearm unlocking, with position reporting and out-of-region alarms.
explain: Fingerprint matching and authorized-region checks jointly gate firearm unlocking, with position reporting and out-of-region alarms.

title: Intelligent weapon
abstract: A system for monitoring use of a weapon. The system includes a monitoring station and at least one weapon in which the weapon fires a projectile. The weapon includes a tracking device, in which the tracking device receives navigational data, and a transceiver. The transceiver transmits at least the navigational data to the monitoring station. The weapon can further include a biometric identifier for identifying a user and a trigger mechanism in which the biometric identifier can enable the trigger mechanism only when the biometric identifier identifies an authorized user. In one arrangement, the tracking device can be a global positioning system receiver that can receive navigational data from a plurality of global positioning system satellites.

title: Real-time iot-based firearm usage, access control and tamper detection system
abstract: The present invention presents an IoT-based firearm monitoring system designed to enhance firearm safety, prevent misuse and enable real-time accountability. The system integrates multi-sensor fusion, including accelerometers, gyroscopes and acoustic or pressure sensors, to detect firearm handling and discharge events with high accuracy. A biometric or RFIDbased authentication module ensures access is restricted to authorized users, while an integrated GPS or GNSS receiver provides continuous geolocation tracking. A microcontroller unit performs event classification, encryption and secure transmission of data to a cloud-based analytics platform via Wi-Fi, LTE, NB-IoT or LoRa networks. The platform enables AI-assisted anomaly detection, alerts for unauthorized or abnormal activity and secure historical logging. The system includes tamper detection and fail-safe local data storage, and can be implemented as a retrofit module or factory-integrated firearm system.

title: Firearm Safety Assembly
abstract: A firearm safety assembly for preventing the firearm from being discharged by an unauthorized user includes a processor coupled to a firearm. A fingerprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The fingerprint scanner may read an authorized user's fingerprint. The fingerprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A thumbprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The thumbprint scanner may read the authorized user's thumbprint. The thumbprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A trigger lock is coupled to the firearm. The trigger lock is operationally coupled to the processor. The trigger lock allows the firearm to be fired when the processor receives the authorized user's fingerprint and thumbprint. A GPS is coupled to the firearm. The GPS is operationally coupled to the processor. The GPS determining a location of the firearm.

title: Method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm
abstract: A method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm prevents unauthorized persons from firing the firearm. When a person picks up the firearm, a biometric scanner retrieves an unidentified biometric reading off of the person. The biometric scanner can be a palm-print reader and/or a fingerprint reader. If the unidentified biometric reading does not match an authorized user signature stored on a chipset of the firearm, and if the firearm has unlocked its trigger, then the firearm automatically locks its trigger. In addition, the firearm generates and broadcasts an unauthorized-use notification with a wireless communication module. If the unidentified biometric reading does match an authorized user signature stored on the chipset, and if the firearm has locked its trigger, then firearm automatically unlocks its trigger. The firearm also collects situational data from environmental sensors when the firearm discharges a round.

title: System and method for monitoring and securing a military weapon
abstract: A system (100) for monitoring and securing a military weapon is disclosed. A biometric sensing chip (102) senses fingerprint of a user. A biometric recognition module (110) receives user recognition data representative of sensed fingerprint of the user, matches the user recognition data with historical user recognition data, identifies authentication of the user using a neural network accelerator. An access control module (120) enables access to the user for using the military weapon. A data monitoring and securing module (130) tracks user handling data representative of usage of the military weapon by the user in real-time, encrypts the user handling data for security purpose using a physical unclonable function based key generation technique. An actuation module (140) determines pressure of a finger of the user when the access for using the military weapon is obtained, sends activation signal for triggering of the military weapon by based on the pressure determined.

title: Sniper rifle
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of creating a special sniper rifle for conducting targeted operations against enemy terrorist groups near our border and within the country, and also is capable of engaging low-flying air targets (helicopters, UAVs), external equipment of enemy tanks and armored personnel carriers, snipers and is a weapon of small airborne units, long-range infantry reconnaissance groups, etc. In the 75 years since the end of the Second World War, many different models of sniper rifles have been created in the world. This firearm device contains a means of protection against firing by an unregistered person, and has a means of information storage consisting of an image in an electronic system for controlling the firing from the presented weapon, and also stores a special code connected to each bullet fired and a laser system for forming a laser beam that ignites the charge for firing the bullet. Furthermore, the means for protecting the weapon contains physical information intended for allowing the firing from this firearm. Here, physical information is the fingerprint of a person about to use a given firearm, through which that person can be identified. title: Biometric authorization and registration systems and methods
abstract: Biometric authorization and registration systems and methods are disclosed. In one embodiment, the system preferably comprises a firearm (100) that includes a biometric authorization system (105), a plurality of training computers (125), and a server. In the preferred embodiment, the server and the training computer (125) interact to train the biometric authorization system (105) in the firearm (100) to accurately and reliably discriminate between the authorized user and unauthorized users. The server utilizes a training algorithm that takes into account biometric information of not only the authorized user of firearm (100), but also those of a large number of unauthorized users. Such biometric information is utilized to compute one or more discriminants and thresholds for such discriminant(s), which are then transmitted to the biometric authorization system (105) in the firearm (100). If the user is allowed to operate the firearm (100) a predetermined percentage of the time, the discriminant thresholds are fixed. If not, the server adjusts the thresholds, and the process is repeated. In another aspect of the present invention, the system may be utilized to uniquely register the firearm (100) with the authorized user. Similar training algorithms are also disclosed for training biometric authorization systems (105) in devices other than firearms.

title: Weapon trigger interlock and monitoring system
abstract: A firearm activation and monitoring system which tracks, monitors, and automatically prevents a firearm from firing when a user is not in a suitable state of mind or is not an authorized user, as well as a method for activating and monitoring a firearm. The firearm activation and monitoring system generally comprises a firearm having a trigger and grip area, a plurality of biometric sensors located on the grip area which measure biometric data of a user, a trigger interlock, and a main microcontroller. The trigger interlock prevents the trigger from firing the firearm when the trigger interlock is in its normal or default position. To unlock the trigger, the user holds the grip area to activate the biometric sensors, and if the user is in an acceptable mental state, the main microcontroller will send an electrical signal to the trigger interlock, which unlocks the trigger and allows the user to pull the trigger of the firearm.

title: Secure smartphone-operated gun trigger lock
abstract: A battery-powered trigger-locking device, which is configured to be disposed on a gun with a trigger for firing, includes a data receiver, a data memory and a logic device for determining whether data received by the receiver is the same, or substantially the same, as data stored in the memory. If a data match is indicated, the logic device causes an electromagnetic device to move a trigger-locking member to an unlocked position, permitting the gun to be fired. A separate electronic gun key is provided to transmit gun unlock data to the data receiver of the trigger-locking device. This gun unlock data may be a password, a long pseudo-random number or biologic data identifying the gun owner or some other person who is licensed or otherwise authorized to fire the gun.

abstract: An apparatus (300) for firing. The apparatus includes a barrel (302). The apparatus includes a controller (304) connected to the barrel to control whether the barrel can fire. The apparatus includes a mechanism for determining the current biometric signature of the ejector that wants to fire the barrel. The determination mechanism is in communication with said controller. The controller only permits the firing of the barrel if the firing's current biometric signature is recognized by the controller. A method for firing a barrel. title: Gun trigger lock
abstract: The invention discloses a gun trigger lock which comprises a lock body and a locking cover capable of being turned over relative to the lock body. The lock body is provided with an identity recognition device, a control circuit board, a drive device, a locking mechanism and a power source module. The identity recognition device is used for acquiring user identity information and sending the user identity information to the control circuit board. The control circuit board controls the drive device to act according to the comparison result of the identity information. The drive device drives the locking mechanism to act. The power module supplies power to the identity recognition device, the control circuit board and the drive device. The lock cover is provided with a buckle plate bucked to the locking mechanism. The gun trigger lock drops out when opened and is convenient to operate. A miniature worm and gear motor is adopted to drive the locking mechanism and is small in size, low in output power and beneficial to lightweight and miniaturization of the gun trigger lock. The gun trigger lock is further provided with a mechanical emergency unlocking mechanism. The gun trigger lock can be unlocked through the mechanical emergency unlocking mechanism under the emergency condition. A fingerprint unlocking manner, a sound unlocking manner, an RFID unlocking manner, a Bluetooth unlocking manner and the like can be selected and used for the identity recognition device.

title: Fingerprint collection device for access control and personal weapons and other systems controlled thereby
abstract: The numerical aperture (NA) of the optical fiber is reduced to allow the cross-lighting phenomenon of the optical fiber prism assembly to be tolerated so as not to exceed 0.5 if possible. A substantial portion of the light travels along the optical fiber based on a fine image, such as a fingerprint, at an input end of the assembly. At the assembly output, a detector responds to the electrical signal arrangement based on the surface undulations. These signals are processed to check the identity of fingerprints or the like, as well as used to control access to personal weapons, other equipment, facilities, data, or money services. As much as possible, the assembly uses a separation element such as, for example, an optical fiber taper (through which the input light does not cross) that is high NA due to out-of-area absorption of the EMA material. In the case of weapons, an anti-oversight module (which matches the weapon port and must also be cosmetically embodied) holds a portion of the access control and firing system. title: Weapon trigger detection system
abstract: The present invention relates to a detection system for weapon triggers. the invention uses a microscanner at the level of the weapon trigger. Said microscanner (Fig. 1 a) must operate each time a bullet projectile.Caractérisé is fired, in that the microscanner analyzes the imprint of the weapon user, then it sends the analysis result to a microprocessor. Said microprocessor (Fig. A2) compares the sent information and the information saved in an integrated memory card (Fig. 1 A3). When the analyzed fingerprint and the preserved fingerprint are the same, the locking device does not operate. In the event of a detected difference between the analyzed fingerprint and the saved fingerprint. The microcontroller sends an electric signal through a battery (Fig. 1 a 5), said electric signal operating an electromagnetic relay (Fig. 1 a 4). The latter locks the weapon sear.

abstract: The biometric firearm chamber lock is a biometric electro-mechanical locking system integrated firearm safety device. The device safely locks firearms by securing the firearm lock into the firearm chamber through the ejection port to prevent rounds from being fired. A mechanical backup unlock mechanism is used if a replacement battery is unavailable or if the electrical components fail and cannot be used to unlock the firearm lock. The firearm lock is an independent structure requiring no installation process.

title: Method and apparatus for secure gun control by using biometrics
abstract: PURPOSE: A safety device for a gun using biometrics and a control method thereof are provided to control permission to use a gun by recognizing the identity of a user from bio information including the iris and finger vein patterns of the user.CONSTITUTION: A safety device for a gun using biometrics comprises an iris recognition part(110), a finger vein recognition part(120), and a controller(130). The iris recognition part is installed in the iron sight of a gun and analyzes infrared rays reflected off user's eyes to obtain an iris image. The finger vein recognition part is installed in the trigger of the gun, scans infrared rays to user's finger contacting the trigger, and analyzes the infrared ray passing through the finger to obtain a finger vein image. The controller extracts iris pattern information and finger vein pattern information from the iris and finger vein images, performs user authentication using the iris pattern information or finger vein pattern information, and controls the lock device of the gun according to the user authentication result.COPYRIGHT KIPO 2011

title: Safety device and method for weapons and cartridges
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for firing a cartridge (3) for weapons and to a method and a device for safeguarding the firing of a cartridge for weapons. The invention provides a cartridge that comprises a safety mechanism. In another preferred embodiment, the weapon reads an identification from the cartridge and uses said identification, together with additional data to calculate a cartridge password. The latter is transmitted to the cartridge, which then decides whether or not to fire. The invention therefore provides devices and methods, which safeguard the weapon against inadvertent and/or unauthorised use. In addition, the inventive device and method also safeguard the cartridge against inadvertent, improper and/or unauthorised firing. Biometric data of the operator, such as a fingerprint, can also be used in the calculation of the cartridge password.

title: Secured firearm
abstract: The present invention describes a secured firearm, including semi-automatic pistols and revolvers, which has a permanently mounted locking device 1 in front of a trigger guard 3 and under a barrel 4. The locking device 1 locks a locking bar 7 which restricts the movement of a slide 5 or a cylinder 30, thereby disabling the secured firearm. The locking device 1 is attached to the outside of the secured firearm. Therefor, the impact on the inside of the secured firearm can be minimized. Any kind of lock can be used as the locking device 1 as long as it is compact enough to be installed in the housing of the locking device 1. For example, a key lock, a combination lock, an electric lock, and a biometric lock such as fingerprint authentication are all applicable to the locking device 1. The locking device 1 is fixed to the secured firearm firmly with screws from inside of the frame, whereby unauthorized dismantling of the locking device 1 is prevented. There is no possibility that the locking device 1 is lost during the secured firearm is used. It does not contact a trigger nor a hammer. Therefore, there is no possibility of accidental firing of the secured firearm due to mishandling of the locking device 1. The locking device 1 is applicable to both current handguns and newly designed handguns.

title: System and method for authenticating an identity for a biometrically-enabled gun
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention may include a biometrically-enabled gun. The biometrically-enabled gun may detect a presence of a user. In response to detecting a presence of a user, a processor may be awoken from a power-saving mode. The processor may query for a presence of a finger of a user. A fingerprint image may be captured. A template of the captured fingerprint image may be generated. A correlation between the template and one or more authorized user templates may be determined. In response to the correlation exceeding a threshold, a processor may cause an actuator may unlock the gun. In response to a lapse of user contact with the gun, a processor may cause the actuator to lock the gun.

title: Biometric detection system and method preventing unauthorized use
abstract: A biometric detection system and method for controlling the unauthorized use of weapons, such as handguns, aircraft, heavy machinery and potentially dangerous instruments. abstract: An AI device, attached to or in a firearm, a processor, camera, front and rear lens, laser to assist sighting. AI identifies “friend” or “foe” images on camera screen. title: Magazine and its intelligent verification system comprising a cartridge chamber, a cartridge support spring, a cartridge support plate, a casing, and a locking mechanism to allow dedicated personnel to use the magazine through fingerprint comparison and facial recognition
abstract: The present invention relates to a magazine and its intelligent verification system, comprising: a cartridge chamber, with an upper end provided with a cartridge opening, adapted to accommodate a plurality of bullets; a cartridge support spring positioned at the bottom of the cartridge chamber; a cartridge support plate located at the upper end of the cartridge support spring; a casing, which encloses the cartridge chamber, cartridge support spring, and cartridge support plate; and a locking mechanism, which is disposed between the sidewall of the cartridge chamber and the casing to lock and seal the cartridge opening, thereby preventing the loading and unloading of bullets. This invention enables bullet control and achieves single-gun, single-person usage. The main structure involves installing a locking mechanism on the magazine as an execution unit, while also providing a control module. The control module intelligently manages the magazine, and when in use, fingerprint comparison and facial recognition enable dedicated personnel to use the magazine.

title: Gun System and Gun Control Management System Prohibit Gun Violence in Reactive and Proactive
abstract: The Gun System and Gun-Control Management System is a two part system to thwart gun violence in any places. The Gun System is a microprocessor with memory and supporting components that are embedded in the gun. The CPU of the Gun System executes software with data from the memory to identify authorized users with stand-alone electrical device; to discharge Unauthorized user with remote power switch or systems; to prohibit firearm use in restricted areas such as schools and other public places with GPS device and disable the gun trigger by moving it into the locked position with disabling device. In this way, the gun system thwarts gun violence in a reactive mode. The Gun-Control Management system maintains a plurality of database in communication with multiple gun systems to thwarts gun violence in proactive mode.

title: Firearm locking system
abstract: A locking system for a firearm is disclosed. A lock has a set state and an unset state, and substantial movement of any one or more fire control group components is inhibited with in the set state. A biometric sensor attachable to a grip of the firearm is receptive to an input biometric feature data set corresponding to a physiological feature of a user. A biometric input controller stores biometric feature data sets corresponding to enrolled user identities in a memory, and compares it against the input biometric feature data set to generate a biometric input validation status indicator signal. A proximity sensor attachable to the grip detects possession of the firearm by the user and generates a corresponding grip detection indicator signal.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent automatic safety valve for a light weapon and a mounting method of the intelligent automatic safety valve. The intelligent automatic safety valve comprises a rotary valve disc, wherein a buckling cover is movably connected to the interior of the top end of the middle section of the rotary valve disc, a motor is fixedly mounted in the buckling cover, a fingerprint verifier is fixedly mounted on the right side edge of the rotary valve disc, an identification center is fixedly mounted on the right side in the rotary valve disc, a controller is fixedly mounted in the left side of the rotary valve disc, and a power connection pipe is fixedly mounted at the bottom end of the controller. title: Biometric quick release gun lock
abstract: A quick biometric gun lock has a hinge located between two sides such that the two sides open and close about the hinge and a cavity between the two sides for reception of the finger protector and trigger mechanism of a gun such that the quick biometric gun lock encloses the trigger and finger protection area. A control shaft is attached to one of the sides having teeth for closure of the gunlock and extends into a hollow area of the other side. title: Biometric gun lock
abstract: A gun lock device and firearm security system configured to prevent unauthorized use of a firearm. The gun lock device includes a lower housing, an upper housing, and a locking mechanism comprising a motor and a latch pin. The latch pin is actuated by the motor to engage or disengage a catch pin, thereby locking or unlocking the device. A control circuit, powered by an internal power source, controls the motor based on external signals, which may be received wirelessly. The system further includes a mobile device that captures biometric data, such as a fingerprint, and communicates with the control circuit to authorize unlocking of the gun lock. A cable is connected to the gun lock device to provide additional physical security. Tamper detection sensors and an audible alert system can also be integrated to enhance security and provide feedback upon unlocking attempts.

title: Electronic lock system of firearms trigger
abstract: The Electronic Lock System of Firearms Trigger receives a long-distance command (remote control), via radio control, to lock the trigger of the weapon, verifies the database if this command is valid and sent by management team and, if so, keeps the trigger locked or locks it, and does not allow unauthorized people make use of the weapon. The Electronic Locking System of Firearms Trigger consists of a transceiver - transmitter / receiver (2), which will receive the command from long- distance lock. The received information will be analyzed by a microcontroller (3) that it will give the permission to make shots. The decision will be sent to a microdrive (4) that, if the user has authorization, or if there is no order of locked, release the trigger (6). If the user has been unauthorized remotely by management team, the trigger (6) will not be released. If the trigger (6) already released and a locked command is sent during use, a decision will be sent from the microcontroller (3) to the microdrive (4), that it will lock the trigger (6) and prevent the user from making new shots.

Upon the entry of a personal code via keypad 17, in addition to an associated display being given on LCD 18, power is supplied to the solenoid via a transistor switch which is energised by a current from a microprocessor. A removable personal identity module (SIM card) 19 which contains pre-programmed personal identity information for a particular user (and with which the information entered by the user into keypad 17 is compared) is engaged in cavity 20. Upon the entry of a correct code, the microprocessor activates the transistor switch and with draws the pin from engagement with the trigger root, allowing the gun to be fired. title: Firearm automatic locking system and method
abstract: This invention is a firearm automatic locking system and method using an emitter that produces an alternating electromagnetic field to induce an eddy current in an encoder presented by an authorized user of the firearm. A sensor in the firearm detects a unique signature of the eddy current, which unique signature is based on any combination of the size, weight, composition and shape of the encoder, which is typically a ring worn by the authorized user. The eddy current signature is then compared electronically to a pre-determined value. If the signature and value are equivalent, a power circuit is closed providing an electrical current to an electrical device, thereby mechanically enabling the firing mechanism of the firearm. As long as the encoder is in adequate proximity to the automatic locking system, the weapon can be fired. To conserve battery power, the automatic locking system is activated only when a magnetic reed switch is activated.

title: Management and reporting system for firearms firing
abstract: TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES IN THIS CENTURY, FROM NEW IDEAS, ALLOW TO CREATE SAFER SOCIETIES. SECURITY IS AN ESSENTIAL PILLAR OF LIFE IN SOCIETY, AS IT INFLUENCES THE WELL-BEING OF ALL CITIZENS. IN THIS SENSE, THIS INNOVATION ALLOWS TO SAFEGUARD FUTURE GENERATIONS OF INSECURITY FROM FIREARMS, THROUGH THE CREATION OF A FIRE ALERT SYSTEM, MADE WITH FIREARMS.THE FACT THAT THERE IS NO SYSTEM ALREADY DEVELOPED (HARMONIZED AND IMPLEMENTED) OF THE REFERRED SYSTEM MAKES THE CONCEPT HAS TO BE DEVELOPED FROM SCRATCH, AND IT WAS CREATED THROUGH THE NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL RULES IN FORCE. REGARDING THE CHARACTERISTICS OF THE INNOVATION, IT WAS DECIDED TO CREATE THE PRESENT INNOVATION CONSISTS OF A MANAGEMENT AND REPORTING SYSTEM OF FIRE (1.1.1), WITH INTELLIGENT FIREARMS (1), THROUGH WIRELESS COMMUNICATION (2), WITH THE MANAGEMENT CENTER AND PROCESSING OF INTELLIGENT FIREARMS. DITO SYSTEM COMMUNICATES BIDIRECTIONALLY (TWO DIRECTIONS). THE COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE INTELLIGENT FIREARM (1) AND THE CENTER (3) IS INFORMATIVE (COMMUNICATION OF INFORMATION ON THE SHOT (1.1.1) PERFORMED) AND DESIGNATED OF D1, WHILE THE COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE CENTER (3) AND THE INTELLIGENT FIREARM (1) IS INSTRUCTIONAL (COMMUNICATION OF INSTRUCTIONS (6)) AND DESIGNATED OF D2 THE CENTER (3) KEEPS ALL COMMUNICATIONS FOR REFERENCE OF THE HISTORY. THE MODULES (4) AND SENSORS (5) IMPLEMENTED IN THE INTELLIGENT FIREARM (1) ALLOW THE FOLLOWING CHARACTERISTICS: TO PERFORM COMMUNICATION (2), WIRELESS, BIDIRECTIONAL, GLOBAL, QUICK AND EFFECTIVE; SENDING INFORMATION ABOUT THE SHOOTING (1.1.1), THROUGH MESSAGE (2.1); RECEIPT OF INSTRUCTIONS (6), FROM THE CENTER (3); THE POSSIBILITY OF REMOTE INHIBITION (8); THE IDENTIFICATION OF PROXIMITY (7). THUS, A SET OF ELEMENTS WAS DEVELOPED TO CREATE A ROBUST, RELIABLE AND REASONABLE MONETARY INVESTMENT INNOVATION.

The gun may collect authentication data, such as biometric data or token data, and the gun may identify the user operating the gun based on the authentication data. The device may process the data to determine i) a location of the gunshot event and ii) a time of the gunshot event. The device may generate an incident report based on the data, where the incident report indicates a use of force incident, the location of the gunshot event, and the time of the gunshot event. The device may encrypt the incident report using an encryption key to produce an encrypted version of the incident report, and the device may store the encrypted version of the incident report in a database.

title: Multi-Sensor Firearm Shot Detection and Analysis System
abstract: A multi-sensor shot detection system and method for accurately identifying and recording gunfire initiated by a user while filtering out ambient gunshots in shared shooting environments. The system integrates motion and acoustic sensors, with data fused into a unified feature vector and processed using a trained classification model to identify valid shot events in real time. The device includes an adaptive calibration process to tune detection parameters to specific firearms and user characteristics. Sensor data is processed locally and may include biometric, environmental, and location-based inputs. Processed event records are stored and synchronized with external applications to support advanced analytics and long-term performance tracking. The system is deployable in wearable and firearm-mounted configurations, enabling high-accuracy detection and context-aware feedback across various use cases.

title: Police intelligent automatic aiming air gun and control method and system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a police intelligent automatic aiming air gun and a control method and system thereof. The air gun integrates an AI technology, a 5G network and a Beidou positioning system, has intelligent automatic aiming and remote monitoring functions, and aims at improving the precision and safety of police non-lethal weapons. The gun structurally comprises a rotatable gun barrel, a gun barrel cover, a sighting device, a rotary adjuster, a bullet feeding flexible connector, a magazine, a trigger, an on-off key, an air tank, a micro air compressor, a handle, a battery and the like. When the system is started, the system performs self-inspection and is connected with a police service monitoring center through a 5G network, and the identity of a user is verified and authorized. Police officers can select a target through a head-mounted display and a gun-mounted sighting device, the system automatically adjusts the sighting angle by using an AI human body and face recognition function, supports various bullet types, synchronously uploads gun positions, on-site videos and shooting information to a monitoring center, and enhances on-site commanding and post-analysis capabilities. According to the technical background, the fields of computer vision, a sensor technology, an artificial intelligence algorithm, precision mechanical design and the like are fused, the habits of a shooter and a precision mechanical structure are learned through high-speed image recognition, high-precision sensor detection and an AI algorithm, and the stability and durability of the firearm are ensured. Meanwhile, the feedback control system dynamically adjusts the aiming point, a user interface can be set in a user-defined mode, and data sharing and remote control are achieved through the wireless communication technology. The development of the air gun strictly complies with laws, adopts preventive measures to prevent abuse, and provides an advanced tool for the field of law enforcement.

title: System and method for real-time detection of illegal forest activities using acoustic sensor networks and adaptive alert generation
abstract: The present invention discloses an autonomous, distributed acoustic sensor network and adaptive alert generation system specifically configured for the real - time detection, classification, and spatio-temporal localization of illegal forest activities, such as poaching and unauthorized logging. The system comprises a plurality of hermetically sealed, solar-powered acoustic sensor nodes deployed throughout a forest canopy. Each node features an acoustic transducer array coupled to an edge-processing microcontroller running an advanced signal processing module and a machine learning pattern recognition engine. The system continuously filters out complex ambient environmental background noise to accurately isolate and classify the unique acoustic signatures of mechanical chainsaws and firearm discharges. title: Electronic trigger safety system with authorized user verification, automatic and fault control (fail-safe)
abstract: The invention relates to the field of safety devices used in firearms with a trigger mechanism. It is especially about systems where electronic and mechanical components that automatically lock and release the trigger mechanism with user verification and remain in a safe position in case of power failure and failure. The verification process is automatically initiated during the user's weapon natural grip movement, and the locking element releases the trigger mechanism if the verification belongs to the authorized user. The trigger mechanism remains locked by default in cases such as failure of user verification, weapon release, power failure or system failure. In this way, the system has a hardware fail-safe structure and provides safe operation in all conditions. The invention combines electronic user verification with mechanical locking, providing an automated and integrated trigger security solution that is not dependent on user error.

title: Sensor array for unauthorized user prevention device
abstract: Improvements in the sensor array are disclosed for an array used in a module for preventing unauthorized use of a firearm or other device. The module to which the invention is applicable of the type including a plurality of pressure sensors for sensing a user's handgrip on the device; comparator means for comparing a pressure signature profile compiled from an output from said pressure sensors with at least one pressure signature profile in storage; and means for preventing operation of the device when the compared profiles do not match. The improved sensor array comprises a first set of spaced electrically conductive lines formed on the gripping surface; a thin layer of (preferably) piezoresistive material overlying the first set of conductive lines; and a second set of spaced electrically conductive lines formed over the piezoresistive layer. The lines of the second set are orthogonal to the lines of the first set, to establish a grid-like pattern of conductive lines sandwiching the piezoresistive layer. The projected intersections between the lines of the first and second sets (i.e., the grid crossing points) thereby define with the intervening portion of the piezoresistive layer, an array of sensors which are responsive to pressure applied against the gripping surface by a user of the device. Such pressure changes the electrical conductivity in the path including the intersecting lines and intervening piezoresistive material. Signal outputs from the electrical paths including the array of sensors serve to define the pressure signal profile.

abstract: Disclosed is a multifunctional practical training experience device. The device comprises a perceiving module, a network module, and an application module. title: Testing of gunshot sensors
abstract: Techniques for gunshot sensor testing are disclosed. An acoustic generator and infrared generator are disposed in a housing. Soundproofing insulation is distributed around and/or within the housing to provide sound deadening which minimizes disturbance to building occupants during testing. The housing is placed in proximity to a gunshot sensor. A trigger device enables multiple modes of triggering both the acoustic generator and infrared generator. The generators stimulate corresponding components of a gunshot sensor. Input from the gunshot sensor components is evaluated to determine an operating condition of the gunshot sensor. The gunshot sensor verifies its operation by communicating with a server. The server further tests mass communication channels by issuing a test message. The test results indicative of the condition of the gunshot sensor are sent to a mobile device for an operator to review.

title: Universal trigger locking system
abstract: Systems for universally locking a trigger of a firearm are provided that require authentication to transition the firearm to an unlocked state. In general, examples of the systems for universally locking a trigger of a firearm described herein are located in an interchangeable grip portion of the firearm or mounted to an accessory rail of the firearm. Embodiments of the system generally include trigger interference or blocking members to prevent actuation of the trigger until the authentication system has authorized the user to fire the firearm. title: Ai-driven surveillance for combatting poaching and illegal hunting rainforest birds
abstract: A system and a method of AI-driven surveillance enables automated detection of poaching activities and monitoring of bird vocalizations in rainforest environments are disclosed. The system includes a plurality of low-power acoustic sensors configured to capture ambient audio signals and a cloud-based processing unit communicatively linked to the sensors. The processing unit includes a memory and processor that execute instructions to filter background noise, extract spectrogram and frequency features, and classify the audio using a machine learning classifier selected from CNN, RNN, SVM, random forest, or gradient boosting models. Upon identifying gunshots or distress bird calls, the system generates and transmits real-time alerts to conservation authorities. The classifier is continuously updated using new data and feedback, improving accuracy and adaptability over time. The system offers scalable, real-time, and non-intrusive wildlife conservation monitoring.

title: Gunshot identification using acoustic signals
abstract: This invention is an acoustic signature-based gunshot detection platform designed for rapid and reliable identification of gunfire incidents in real time. It uses a high-sensitivity microphone with a microcontroller like ESP32 to continuously monitor environmental sounds. Advanced algorithms analyze audio features such as high amplitude and sharp impulses to distinguish gunshots from background noise. When a gunshot is detected, the system captures the location using GPS and transmits the data, including time and coordinates, via Wi-Fi or GSM to a central server. The incident is securely logged for analysis and investigation. Real-time alerts are sent to authorities, enabling quick response. A monitoring dashboard helps visualize locations, track history, and analyze patterns. This integration of acoustic sensing, signal processing, and IoT ensures an efficient and scalable solution for public safety.

According to the method, a light load trip line is preset at a key node, a suspicious attack log is generated in combination with a hidden Markov model, and multi-channel instant early warning is triggered; extracting multi-dimensional fingerprints of a browser, hardware and a special network weapon to construct a warehouse, and generating three types of flight fragments of deep acquisition, remote control and vulnerability repair for precise delivery; and performing confusion packing processing on the control software, and realizing active traceability deterrence in a matching/non-matching mode. According to the invention, threat identification accuracy and response speed are improved, an active defense closed loop is formed, and the method is suitable for security protection of a power system network.

title: Method and apparatus for remotely monitoring and controlling embedded weapon system
abstract: According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a method and an apparatus for remotely monitoring and controlling an embedded weapon system can remotely monitor and control an embedded weapon system, thereby enabling administrators to remotely monitor the state of the embedded weapon system or control the embedded weapon system regardless of user interface in the embedded weapon system not having a GUI or a monitor and enabling developers of the embedded weapon system to easily use a remote control function without the need to separately implement the remote control function each time, and can remotely restore a specific function without re-execution after termination of the software of the embedded weapon system. title: Electric anastomat capable of intelligently recognizing different types of cutting assemblies
abstract: The utility model relates to an electric anastomat capable of intelligently identifying different types of cutting assemblies. The electric anastomat comprises a gun body assembly and the cutting assemblies. The cutting assembly is installed on the gun body assembly and has at least two types according to the length. A connecting part is arranged at the tail part of the cutting assembly; the lengths of the connecting parts of any two cutting assemblies are different; a control panel with a contact switch is arranged in the gun body assembly; the number of contacts on the contact switch is not smaller than the number of the types of the cutting assemblies. The gun body assembly is further provided with a sliding contact block sliding front and back, and the tail of the sliding contact block is provided with a pressure spring. When the cutting assembly is mounted on the gun body assembly, the connecting part triggers the sliding contact block to move backwards, so that the sliding contact block is in contact with the contact switch; the strokes completed by the sliding contact block triggered by the cutting assemblies of different models are different. The utility model has the advantages that the anastomat and the switching component are convenient to operate, and an identity recognition chip/driver corresponding to the cutting component does not need to be manually operated or attached for re-confirmation.

title: Firearm safety mechanisms, visual safety indicators, and related techniques
abstract: The techniques described herein relate to methods and apparatus for firearm safety mechanisms, visual safety indicators, and related techniques. A firearm includes a handle comprising one or more buttons disposed at least partially within a surface of the handle, such that the one or more buttons can be in contact with an operator's hand when the operator grasps the handle; a safety mechanism in mechanical communication with the trigger. title: Intelligent safety trigger lock for gun
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent safety trigger lock for a gun. The intelligent safety trigger lock comprises a left lock seat and a right lock seat which are locked to each other. The side edge of the left lock seat and the side edge of the right lock seat are hinged. The left lock seat comprises a lock hook and a locking mechanism which drives the lock hook to act. The right lock seat comprises a lock catch and a master control module which controls the locking mechanism to act. The lock catch is fixedly arranged at one side of the right lock seat. The locking mechanism comprises a motor, a worm wheel and worm mechanism, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod and a fixing plate, wherein the motor is arranged in the left lock seat. The middle of the second connecting rod is connected into the left lock seat in a pivoted manner. The lock catch is movably mounted onto the fixing plate through a torsional spring. A driving shaft of the motor is connected with the input end of the worm wheel and worm mechanism. The output end of the worm wheel and worm mechanism is hinged to a first end of the first connecting rod. A second end of the first connecting rod is hinged to a first end of the second connecting rod. A second end of the second connecting rod is in limited fit with the lock catch. The intelligent safety trigger lock is reasonable in structural arrangement; the connecting rod type torsional spring locking mechanism is controlled through the master control module; safety performance is improved; and unlocking can be conducted conveniently and rapidly.

title: Complex special-shaped workpiece full-feature detection method based on virtual ray model
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial intelligent detection and precise measurement, and discloses a full-feature detection method for a complex special-shaped workpiece based on a virtual ray model. By establishing a virtual ray projection model, mapping complex two-dimensional profile features into one-dimensional time sequence signals in a dimension reducing manner, utilizing geometric fingerprints to realize mixed line identification, realizing tooling-free phase alignment through minimum mean square error, constructing a dynamic confidence interval based on a local noise map, and realizing accurate detection of size deviation and topological structure of a workpiece. Unlike traditional vision, which only measures the surface size, the invention combines topology layer number verification, and can effectively identify deep defects such as internal structure deficiency (such as fracture and non-drilling). The recognition mechanism based on the geometric fingerprint enables the system to automatically recognize the model of the workpiece and call the corresponding program without an external sensor (such as a code scanning gun), and the flexible production line is perfectly adapted.

abstract: A firearm safe is described which may provide a firearm in a state for ready access such that release of the firearm from the safe is performed when a user's hand is in position to readily accept and use the firearm with no or minimal avoidance of obstructions. The firearm safe may maintain the firearm in a locked and protected position when access is not desired and may carry the firearm on a carriage assembly. abstract: A firearm security system for securing a firearm and alerting an owner of the firearm when an unauthorized user accesses the firearm is disclosed. The first processor transmits an alert to an electronic device of the owner when the firearm is removed from the magnetic section without the authentication mechanism, indicating that an unauthorized user removed the firearm from the rack. title: RFID or Biometric Locking Mechanism Fitted on a Concealed Pocket of a Container Operated via a Mobile Application or Through an RFID Article or Other Biometric Technologies
abstract: A concealed carry weapon (CCW) container offers a user a fail-secure locking mechanism to ensure that the CCW stays locked at all times even when there is no power. The CCW container enables the user to quickly and automatically unlock when the user utilizes the biometric recognition system, a pass code, or an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) tag. The CCW container employs interior and exterior lighting, quick access magnetic closure with or without a locking mechanism attached, and a ballistic armor plate to protect the user's vital body parts using the ballistic armor plat as a shield. Further, a method for managing the fail-secure locking mechanism allows the user to efficiently access the CCW content using a mobile app, the RFID tag, or any other biometric technology. Additionally, the method provides a panic switch that alerts security authorities of an incident and forwarding any salient video or sound thereto.

title: Safety system for firearms
abstract: The firearm enable/disable electronics system includes a base unit (1) integrated into the firearm (7) and a safety (4). Each of the base unit (1) and the safety device (4) has a transceiver (2,5) for exchanging/processing wireless command signals with each other. The safety has an actuating circuit (6), which is controlled by the transceiver of the safety (4) and actuates the locking mechanism (8). In this case, the locking mechanism operates to prevent the firearm from firing. The wireless command signal (9) operates within a predetermined distance between the base unit and the safety, and when the safety is located within a predetermined distance from the base unit, the transceiver exchanges the wireless command signal, causing the transceiver of the safety to prompt the operating circuit to operate the locking mechanism. title: Improvements to semi-automatic wiring machines
abstract: 1279573 Interconnecting electrical connectors INTERNATIONAL STANDARD ELECTRIC CORP 15 Jan 1970 [17 Jan 1969] 1974/70 Heading B3A Apparatus for interconnecting tags on electrical connectors 1 or 2 includes a wiring tool 19 having control means, means for sequentially displaying wiring instructions and testing means for verifying that each instruction has been correctly performed. Printed circuit cards 3, 4 are provided with light guides (5) to indicate the tags to be wired, Fig. 2 (not shown). A switch 9 is closed to send a signal V to a control device 7, thereby sending a signal U to an authorizing device 8, which in turn sends a signal T to a tape reader 6. The tape reader reads the information for wiring a tag A, which information comprises seven eight-bit words and which passes via a selector 10 to seven eight-bit registers. During the reading sequence, a signal W is applied to the devices 7, 8 to maintain the tape reader control signal. A register 11 decodes the first word to identify the correct card and a register 12 determines which line of tags and, if necessary, either the left or right tag of a double row of tags, is to be illuminated. A register 13 selects the correct length of wire to be used and its type by indicating the receptacle of a container 14 in which it is to be found. Alternatively a register 16 controls the supply of wire and determines its length if the wiring is of the same type throughout. When wires have to be connected in a specified order, this is indicated by a register 17, which controls a display device 18. The tool 19 is applied to the indicated tag, which is at an electrical potential of - 2-5 volts. This potential is applied to an amplifier 20 via the tool and it controls a valve 21 in the compressed air line of the tool, which wraps the wire around the tag. At the same time a signal Y is fed to the device 8 to block the tape reader 6. When the connection is completed the last word of the wiring sequence is applied to a checking register 23 which is connected to the other registers via a link 56. If the connection is satisfactory a signal Z is applied to the device 8, but should it be faulty, a device 24 is actuated and further operation of the machine is blocked. To ensure that a connection was made when the gun touched the tag, data in the last word is stored in a register 25, which transmits a signal S to an "AND" gate 22. As the gun 19 iswithdrawn from the tag, the signal Y is cancelled, but the signal Z is maintained, when a connection is made, thereby allowing the signal T to be generated on operation of the switch 9. When the switch 9 is operated again, test information for tag A is processed simultaneously with that for tag B. If tag A is not wired the gun is not usuable, illumination of tag B stops and tag A is illuminated again. If the tag is wired satisfactorily the reader 6 is stepped as the signal T is generated.

title: Ai-driven ethical compliance verification system for autonomous weapon decision pipelines
abstract: The introduction of an AI-Driven Ethical Compliance Verification System seeks to address the issues of monitoring the ethics of operations and the applicability of international law during the decision-making processes of Autonomous Weapon Systems (AWS). This invention will address the issues of ethical supervision in real time during the execution of missions, rather than retrospective supervision, and seeks to incorporate compliance during operational execution. The system integrates pre and post mission sensor data with an ethical rule base pertaining to the principles of distinction, proportionality, and the governing statutes these ethics are overlaying. These ethical principles will calibrate the boundaries of all further autonomous actions. The ability of the system to perform Compliance Check Pre-Execution Modules is unprecedented. The autonomous system constructs a decision tree of all potential actions. For each branch of the tree, the Al filter computes whether the potential decision violates an ethical rule base, and in the circumstances it does, it will be flagged, to allow the system to present various outputs, be they compliance positivity, warning, or the action is alternative to a lesser stressed ethical rule base. The system will allow autonomous systems to operate on a higher-than-expected ethical level and at the same time sustain humans in the ultimate decision-making and application of lethal force in highly complex and ethically challenging environments.

The display panel is situated in a thin housing secured to the firearm along the line of sight of the user. A running total of the number of rounds remaining in the firearm is visible to the user. title: Firearm round counter and assembly
abstract: A round counter assembly for a firearm is provided. title: Method and Apparatus for Precision Tracking of Approaching Magnetic-Detonated and Traditional Impact Torpedoes
abstract: Capturing or impeding traditional or supercavitating torpedoes from striking a side or entering the keel area of a capital ship depends on very precise tracking. Because supercavitating torpedoes travel at about 550 miles/hr, even milliseconds will be vital, perhaps causing a countermeasure weapon, like a supercavitating cannon shell, to disrupt its cavitation but not impeding its slower motion toward the ship. Likewise, capture curtain soft-kill defense allows not one second to be squandered because of inaccurate tracking. One purpose of the invention is to scatter, in and around the roughly calculated path of the torpedo, tiny, inexpensive balls that have sonar, magnetometers and other active and passive sensors to aid Fire Control predicting arrival time and where it will strike. Over time, smaller swarms of measurement balls are continually launched as tracking precision improves. Countermeasures are constantly updated by Fire Control.A second use aids a helicopter that acquired a super quiet submarine; it can initially launch a wide swarm of sensors in the sub's area, and they will continually monitor the movement. As location becomes more precise, smaller swarms are launched in sequence. If the sub dives for safe layers, the swarm detaches the sonar ball and they will sink slowly, using sonar and sending location pinging messages to Fire Control.

abstract: The invention discloses an underground pipeline obstacle removing and damage repairing method and system based on multi-source sensor cooperation. title: Ai-based anomaly detection in cctv surveillance
abstract: An AI-powered CCTV surveillance system for college campuses that automates real-time detection of physical altercations, unauthorized weapons, and distress sounds by fusing deep learning-based video analysis (Two-Stream and 3D CNNs, YOLOv9/v10) with audio classification (MFCC and RNN). A supervised attention enhanced fusion module integrates multi-modal features to enhance detection precision (-90%) and reduce false alarms (-15%). Instant alerts are delivered to a secure dashboard, enabling rapid security responses. The modular, scalable design supports edge or cloud deployment while preserving privacy through human-in-the-loop verification, significantly improving campus safety and operational efficiency.

abstract: This invention introduces a compact, edge-based artificial intelligence system that can monitor crowds and analyze safety in real time at public events. title: Magnetic screening system
abstract: A magnetic screening system uses directional gradiometers with high resolution and accuracy to measure magnetic field signatures of target objects (e.g., gun, knife, cell phone, keys) in a volume of interest. title: Dynamic variable force trigger mechanism for firearms
abstract: A magnetically variable firing system for a firearm includes a trigger mechanism allowing a user to selectively adjust the trigger pull force-displacement profile by changing the static magnetic field in the mechanism. In a closed magnetic loop configuration, the trigger mechanism includes a stationary yoke and pivotably movable trigger member. The trigger member includes a trigger portion and working portion operably interfaced with the firing mechanism of the firearm for discharging the firearm. An openable first air gap formed between the trigger member and yoke is maintained in a closed position via magnetic attraction therebetween absent a trigger pull. A control insert movable relative to a second control air gap in the yoke allows adjustment of the static magnetic field to alter the trigger pull force required to actuate the trigger mechanism. Other embodiments provide an open magnetic loop trigger mechanism design adjustable to magnetically vary the trigger pull force.

title: Safety mechanism for firearm
abstract: A bolt action rifle with safety mechanism includes a receiver, barrel coupled to the receiver, and a trigger housing detachably coupled to the receiver. The trigger housing includes a trigger-actuated firing mechanism operable to discharge the rifle. A safety mechanism comprises a safety shaft and safety selector each rotatably mounted in the trigger housing and operably coupled together by a mechanical linkage, such as a rod in one embodiment. The safety selector comprises a control shaft and selector switch for operating the selector. Rotating the safety selector in a first direction rotates and engages the safety shaft with the trigger to disable the firing mechanism. Rotating the safety selector in a second direction rotates and disengages the safety shaft from the trigger to enable the firing mechanism for discharging the rifle. In one embodiment, the safety selector is mounted in a lower stock which includes a pistol grip.

abstract: The objects of the present invention are to provide technology for facilitating the teaching of subjects using virtual 3-D scenes or environments (such as used in video games or VR displays) in which objects in the virtual scene can have their properties identified using virtual measurement instruments. The object's properties can, thus, be displayed by identifying a virtual instrument and then identifying the object or section of the object, by for example, pointing with a mouse curser and clicking a mouse button. Lessons on subjects can be created by specifying a sequence of objects to be measured, the measurements to be made, the data to be recorded, together with questions about the data and conclusions that can be drawn. Standard lessons can be created by subject matter experts or customized lessons can be created by the teachers of the subject.

title: Firing head/perforating gun latching system and associated methods
abstract: A latching system permits a firing head to be lowered into a wellbore and reliably coupled to a perforating gun previously lowered into the wellbore. In a disclosed embodiment thereof, the latching system includes a tubular collar associated with the firing head, and a stinger associated with the perforating gun. As the firing head approaches the previously lowered perforating gun, shearable studs projecting into the interior of the collar are received in external side surface J-slots formed on the stinger. The latching of the collar studs in the stinger J-slots permits the firing head/perforating gun connection to be verified simply by pulling up on and creating increased tension in the structure, such as a slick line, used to lower the firing head to the perforating gun. After the firing head is used to detonate the perforating gun, the spent firing head may be retrieved by pulling it uphole with sufficient force to shear its collar studs. Cooperating auxiliary attachment structures are formed on the firing head and perforating gun to facilitate their interconnection and simultaneous lowering into the wellbore if desired.

title: Licensing the use of software on a particular cpu
abstract: Software is licensed for use on a particular computing device, such as a gaming console or a multimedia console. An unlocking code is provided from a distribution service to the computing device (either directly or via a user), which in turn, unlocks the appropriate software or portion of software for use with the associated computing device. The software may reside on a computer-readable medium, such as a CD-ROM or DVD disk, that is being used in conjunction with the computing device. The unlocking code may be provided directly to the user in private (e.g., via email or a mobile phone) or in public (e.g., published on a website). Portions of the software that may be unlocked include a particular level of a game or other features (such as additional characters or weapons), or a working or more advanced version of an application that was otherwise provided as a demo or older version. The unlocking code may be based on a unique identifier of the computing device and an identifier associated with the software seeking to be accessed. Thus, the code may only be used by the computing device having that unique identifier. This prevents unauthorized or unlicensed computing devices from using the software.

title: Tamper-actuated fluid release firearm interlock
abstract: Apparatus and associated methods relate to a firearm lock configured to release a self-hardening interlock fluid into a firing chamber of a firearm in response to a predetermined force. In an illustrative example, the firearm lock may include an engagement module configured to releasably couple to a firing chamber of the firearm. In a locked mode, for example, the engagement module may prevent the firearm from firing. The firearm lock may include, for example, a tamper interlock module containing interlock material (IM) in a fluid state. When a predetermined force is applied to the tamper interlock module, for example, the IM may be dispensed from the cavity into the firing chamber and the IM may at least partially transition into a solid state such that the IM prevents the firearm from firing. Various embodiments may advantageously disable a locked firearm in response to tampering with the lock.

title: Message authentication key generation method and device and message authentication system
abstract: The invention provides a message authentication key generation method, a message authentication key generation device and a message authentication system. The message authentication key generation method comprises the following steps of performing post-processing on an original key to obtain a post-processed key; performing safety evaluation on the post-processing key, and deducting the key with a non-conforming safety coefficient in the post-processing key to obtain a safety key; a portion of the safety keys are selected as message authentication keys. Therefore, the authentication key is generated from the obtained safety key, and the authentication key does not need to be replaced through special equipment such as a key gun, so that the message authentication key can be replaced timely and conveniently through the quantum key distribution network. In addition, the key extracted in the basis vector comparison, error correction and confidentiality enhancement processes is stored in the key pool, and then the message authentication is carried out, so that the message authentication is carried out only once, and the safety of the message authentication key is improved.

abstract: FIELD: artillery.SUBSTANCE: claimed method relates to artillery weapons, to the field of diagnostics of automatic control and regulation systems, in particular to the process of using artillery instruments for adjusting the zero line of sights, for monitoring the maintenance of a given relative position of the barrel and the sighting channel of the gunner's sight. If there is a misalignment, the gunner must correct the position of the central aiming mark using the standard sight adjustment tools or SPG devices.EFFECT: increase in the accuracy of firing from the CV armament in combat conditions, as well as an increase in the safety of verification operations carried out by the CV crew.3 cl, 8 dwg

title: Particle Counter
abstract: The present invention relates to a device for measuring particle number concentration capable of measuring an aerosol particle having a more than reference size and an aerosol particle having a less than reference size for a fine aerosol particle in which various sizes are mixed by using a coarse particle detecting unit and a fine particle detecting unit at the same time. The present invention is provided to enable the fine particle detecting unit which measures the aerosol particle having less than the reference size to install each heavy firearm in the front side and the back side of a particle separating device and to neutralize a particle which passes through the particle separating device, thereby minimizing the loss of the aerosol particle when the particle is sent to a condensation nucleus particle counter and improving accuracy of a fine particle measuring result. The present invention is provided to install a separate impactor and an impactor detection measuring unit in the front side of the fine particle detecting unit, thereby limiting the aerosol particle sent to the fine particle detecting unit as a particle having the less than reference size and improving the accuracy of a measured result. The present invention is provided to analyze the number of aerosol particles having the more than reference size collected in the impactor and compare the same with the result of the coarse particle detecting unit, thereby verifying the measured result of the coarse particle detecting unit again.

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and apparatus for monitoring and diagnosing plasma gun performance, capable of determining proper gun operation and if not operating properly, diagnosing potential causes for abhorrent operation.SOLUTION: According to the present invention, a voltage produced by a gun is sampled in real time and a produced frequency spectrum is analyzed using a Fast Fourier Transform FFT and then converting a FFT pattern to a set of numerical values or a signature that can be compared to known signatures for both correct operation and abnormal operation. abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for calculating gun fire data of a projectile. title: Tunnel guide rail advancing fire-fighting robot system and using method
abstract: The invention discloses a tunnel guide rail advancing fire-fighting robot system and a using method. The tunnel guide rail advancing fire-fighting robot system comprises a power supply device, a control device, a fire behavior monitoring device, a magnetic suspension guide rail, a fire source tracking device and a fire extinguishing device. The power supply device supplies power to the whole system; the control device controls actions of all the devices; the fire monitoring device sends signals to the control device after monitoring a fire behavior and stores fire extinguishing videos in realtime for analysis; and the fire extinguishing device moves to a fire occurrence position through the magnetic suspension guide rail according to instructions of the control device. The fire source tracking device tracks the accurate position of a fire source; and the fire extinguishing device extend the length of a gun barrel according to an instruction, moves the gun barrel to enable the gun barrel to be aligned with the fire source and launches a fire extinguishing agent to extinguish fire. According to the tunnel guide rail advancing fire-fighting robot system, flame or smoke can be rapidlyand accurately discovered; an alarm signal can be sent out; the system can rapidly arrive at a fire scene to extinguish fire; a mobile fire source can also be continuously tracked in a dense smoke environment; and the whole process from fire catching to fire extinguishing can be recorded, so that data are provided for postmortem analysis.

title: Unified extractor
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of artillery weapons and can be used in subdivisions for the maintenance and repair of samples of rocket and artillery weapons in the recovery of defective weapons. The urgency and the purpose of the proposed utility model are determined by the necessity to optimize the composition of the technological equipment included in the system for technical maintenance, diagnosis and repair of artillery weapons, which will allow solving the scientific contradiction that has arisen in practice, namely, the ever-increasing requirements for armaments in terms of their serviceability on the one hand and, on the other hand, the tool base of the system that remains at the same level.The objectives of developing the proposed utility model are to:- to increase the serviceability of the artillery part of multiple launch rocket system (MLRS) and barrel artillery samples;- to improve the safety of armament restoration work when damaged vehicles (SPPM) samples of missile and artillery weapons (RAW) are accepted for repair at assembly points;- the improvement of the instrumental base of unified repair and technical platforms (RTAs) by including in their composition a technical solution aimed at the implementation of a non-shooting method for discharging artillery weapons.The aim is achieved by developing a unified extractor for safely discharging artillery weapons.The technical result and the stated aim are achieved by virtue of the proposed utility model can be in the form of a structural technical solution consisting of the following elements: replaceable free-rotating centering rings which can be used for a caliber from 100 to 203 mm inclusively, said rings being fixed and rotated by means of pins for screwdriver grooves and grooves, an adapter which makes it possible to be connected by means of a thread to a standard bar which is included in a single set of spare tools and accessories for the sample of the AMR., and a cylinder made of a thick-walled pipe, the outer diameter of which is equal to 83 mm, and the thickness of said cylinder walls of 12 mm, which allows the product to have high strength indices.The non-firing method for discharging an artillery gun with the aid of the unified extractor proposed by us is carried out in accordance with an algorithm presented below.Algorithm of discharging the artillery gun using a unified extractor.1. According to the caliber of the artillery gun, it is necessary to install replacement centering rings by fixing the pins in grooves located in the cylinder.2. Using a threaded connection on the adapter, connect the extractor to the standard rod;3. Place the assembled unified extractor in the channel of the gun barrel from the muzzle part of the gun. If the MLRS sample is discharged, it will be installed from the side of the vehicle cockpit. Furthermore, the bevel on the cylinder of the unified extractor is in contact with the ogival part of the projectile.4. With careful hammer strikes on the barbell, push the projectile in the direction of the artillery barrel, in order to avoid damage to the barrel bar, strike the barrel through a wooden pad.Thus, the proposed unified extractor can be incorporated into the instrumentation base of the RTP and the 1I41 monitoring and verification machine in order to implement a non-firing method for discharging artillery weapons on the SPM.

title: Safety system with biometric locking applied in holders for size and controlled storage of firearms
abstract: SAFETY SYSTEM WITH BIOMETRIC LOCKING APPLIED IN HOLDERS FOR SIZE AND CONTROLLED STORAGE OF FIREARMS. The present invention patent application relates to a security system (1) described and applied to holsters (2) for the controlled storage of firearms. The present system includes a holster (2) with a locking mechanism (3) operated by a biometric sensor (4). Access to the weapon is restricted to authorized users whose fingerprints are recorded in the security system (1). The holster (2) is molded to fit specifically to the gun, ensuring a secure engagement and preventing accidental firing. The locking mechanism (3) has a locking handle (5) that covers the trigger of the weapon, blocking access to it. The locking handle (5) can only be unlocked by biometric authentication using the biometric sensor (4) strategically located in the holster (2). The biometric sensor (4) is highly sensitive and provides quick access to authorized users. The system also includes a locking base (6) with a locking mechanism (7), activated when an authorized user is identified by the biometric sensor (4), allowing access to the gun trigger. Powered by a battery (8), the system has an alert (9) for low battery. Additionally, it is adaptable to different types and sizes of weapons and can register multiple users, making it suitable for use in police or military forces. The field of application is directed to the sector of safety equipment, more particularly, in secure storage devices for firearms.

title: Stun gun detect
abstract: A method and apparatus for detecting that a stun gun has been deployed is provided herein. During operation a periodic nature of a stun-gun voltage will be utilized to determine if the stun-gun has been fired. title: A smart thermo-capture gel pad for bullet retrieval with integrated striation preservation
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart thermo-capture gel pad for ballistic testing and forensic analysis, designed for retrieval of fired bullets while preserving microscopic striation marks and capturing thermal signatures generated during impact. The gel pad comprises a viscoelastic polymer matrix configured to decelerate projectiles with minimal deformation, along with embedded thermal sensors that record temperature variations during penetration. Microstructured or chemically enhanced regions ensure preservation of bullet surface striations for accurate forensic examination. A data acquisition module enables storage and transmission of thermal and ballistic data for analysis. The system is reusable and compatible with forensic imaging techniques, improving accuracy in firearm identification, terminal ballistics studies, and forensic investigations while enabling integrated structural and thermal data capture from a single recovery medium.

title: Computer aided wire wrap operator check system
abstract: There is disclosed herein an apparatus for computerized real time verification of the correctness of pin locations for wire wrap connections made by human operators in constructing or upgrading computer backplanes. A suitably programmed microprocessor operates from a data base consisting of the information from a wire list drawing fed into the microprocessor's memory from a cassette tape record. The microprocessor is linked to the backplane to be verified and to the hand operated wire wrap gun serving as the test probe by a uniquely designed Wire Check System Interface. Both wire adds and wire deletes may be made. The microprocessor serves to check the operator's badge number for proper authority, bootload the data base, find the sequence of wires to be added or deleted, display the addition or deletion data on a CRT by identifying the "from" and "to" pins, and to verify the correct placement of the wire wrap gun by the operator by lighting a red or green LED and sounding an audible alarm on red when an index/test strip switch is activated by the operator. Printed reports of wire check errors are also generated. In the preferred embodiment, use of the computer aided wire wrap operator check system can be expected to reduce wiring errors to an average of five errors per upgraded or newly constructed system-a figure which can result in substantial cost savings.
