abstract: The invention provides a method and system for controlling the end of vehicle charging. The method comprises the following steps: detecting that a user approaches and unlocking a vehicle; sending a vehicle lock state signal to the charging device; and the charging device judges that the charging end condition is met and controls charging to be stopped. The system comprises a vehicle charging control module and a vehicle lock device control module. When the vehicle detects that a user is close to the vehicle, the vehicle lock device control module controls the vehicle to be unlocked and then sends a vehicle lock state signal to the charging device, and if the charging device judges that the charging end condition is met, charging is controlled to be stopped. By judging the automatic unlocking state of the vehicle and the pressing state of the microswitch, charging is controlled to be finished, the charging gun lock device is controlled to be unlocked, non-inductive charging ending and gun pulling can be achieved, and the steps of charging ending are reduced.

title: Method and system to determine quick pass write operation in increment step pulse programming operation
abstract: A method for determining quick-pass-write (QPW) operation in increment-step-program-pulse (ISPP) operation is provided. The QPW operation is simultaneously applying a bit line voltage during the ISPP operation. The method includes, according to bit line voltages varying in a first range and voltage difference values varying in a second range with respect to a verified voltage, estimating a shrinkage quantity of threshold voltage distribution width at each bit line voltage and each voltage difference value, so as to obtain a shrinkage-quantity topographic contour. According to the bit line voltages and the voltage difference values, a program shot number as needed to achieve the verified voltage is estimated, so as to obtain a program-shot-number topographic contour. The shrinkage-quantity topographic contour and the program-shot-number topographic contour are overlapped to determine an operation region formed from an application range of the bit line voltage and an application range of the voltage difference value.

abstract: The invention discloses a method for conducting advanced grouting reinforcement on a deep-buried long tunnel on the earth surface. title: Method for determining influence of environment temperature on verification error of oiling machine
abstract: The invention discloses a method for determining the influence of environment temperature on the verification error of an oiling machine. The method comprises the steps of placing a measuring instrument on a hard flat ground; starting the oiling machine, starting an oil gun, and adjusting the oil gun to the maximum flow during verification, determining the maximum flow during field verification through timing of a stopwatch, and after the measuring instrument is filled with oil, putting the oil gun back to a bracket; starting the oiling machine, enabling an indicating device of the oiling machine to return to zero, enabling the measuring instrument to be filled with oil under multiple flow conditions, monitoring changes of oil temperature in a muzzle and the measuring instrument at any time in the process, and reading and recording an indicating value of the measuring instrument after oil foam and bubbles in the measuring instrument disappear; and changing the environment temperature, repeating the operation, and drawing an influence graph of the environment temperature change on the verification error. According to the invention, through simple and easy operation, the influence of the environment temperature change on the verification error of the oiling machine can be visually obtained, the repeated use of the thermometer in the verification process of the oiling machine is avoided, the metering verification efficiency is effectively improved, and the verification cost is reduced.

title: Method for Determining Potential Shift or Match Quality of Communication Operating Levels during Electronic Modules in a Wire Bus Network and Apparatus for Implementing the Method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for determining the matching quality of a potential shift between electronic modules in a wire material bus network or a communication operation level in a network composite, wherein a bus medium comprises at least one wire material, and the wire material is electrically connected to the electronic modules. In the present invention, at least one bus subscriber (test subscriber) is applied with an offset voltage at a transmitting side to (at least) one of normal source levels that are dominant (both), and a bus-notification is transmitted from the test subscriber in this state to the bus network. In this case, the source level is changed in a prescribed form. Depending on whether (at least) one of the (both) dominant source levels is lowered or raised by each settable offset voltage, the bus subscriber, which includes the (reference) potential error, loses or acquires its receiving capability. This is appreciated. According to the present invention, a device includes a potential control means which is coupled or can be coupled to a transceiver function of a bus subscriber and performs joint operation, and by these, at least one controllable voltage source is realized with respect to at least a part of the transmission-and/or reception means of the transceiver function. The voltage source can affect at least one source level which is dominant in the case of transmission and/or at least one signal level which is discriminatory in the case of reception.

title: Method for evaluating artificial precipitation enhancement effect of rocket
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial precipitation enhancement, in particular to a rocket artificial precipitation enhancement effect evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of collecting meteorological data, landform information and historical precipitation records of an operation area, and performing data cleaning and standardization processing; based on the collected data, a calculation model of the rocket artificial precipitation enhancement influence area is constructed, and model verification is carried out through historical data; in the operation process, meteorological changes and silver iodide diffusion conditions are monitored in real time, operation parameters are adjusted according to actual conditions, and the precipitation increasing effect is optimized; and after the operation is finished, comprehensively evaluating the precipitation enhancement effect in combination with precipitation amount, influence area and operation amount data, and outputting an evaluation result. According to the scheme, the artificial precipitation enhancement effect can be quantitatively evaluated, data support is provided for owners, and benefits are enhanced. Meanwhile, ammunition amount control is guided, and the optimal operation effect is ensured. According to the method, the influence range can be accurately measured and calculated, and the operation efficiency and effect are evaluated.

title: Method for firing by guided missile and missile guidance system
abstract: FIELD: methods for firing by guided missiles and optical sighting devices of self-propelled missile guidance systems. SUBSTANCE: in using the method for firing by a guided missile with on optical communication line with the ground control system including the operations of missile launching and control of it during flight from the ground equipment, alignment of the launcher axis with the sight optical axis is preliminarily performed, alignment is performed in two stages. First alignment of the axes is carried out, the aligned position of the axes is fixed and the error signals are read off, the error signals in the aligned position are memorized, then in the process of service of the control system the operation of alignment is repeated, at a repeated alignment the conformity of the obtained error signals with the error signals corresponding to the memorized ones at the first alignment, and in case of a misalignment of the mentioned error signals, corrections depending on the angles of deviation of the axes in the initially aligned position and misalignment obtained at the repeated alignment are introduced in the error signals at firing. The repeated alignment is preferably performed systematically with a preset periodicity. After a repeated alignment the range to the target is measured and the direction of the launcher axis is set in accordance with the functional dependence from the measured range and corrections introduced after the repeated alignment taken into account. After the performed operations a fire is shot. The method is realized with the aid of the missile guidance system containing the guided missile, launching system with the missile type driver and the optical sight included in the composition of the launcher. The system is featured by the fact that it contains a device for optical communication of the launcher with the sight provided with a turning gear, and a launcher guidance drive with a launcher axis position pickup connected to the control bus, connected to which are also the launching system, optical sight and the launching control processor introduced in the system. EFFECT: enhanced accuracy and reliability of the armament complex. 5 cl, 3 dwg

title: Method for monitoring operation error of metering equipment in direct current charging station
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of charging stations, and particularly relates to a method for monitoring operation error of metering equipment in a direct current charging station. In order to overcome the defect that an on-site verification system is adopted to detect the operation error of a charging station at present, the invention adopts the following technical scheme. The method for monitoring the operation error of the metering equipment in the direct current charging station comprises the following steps: establishing an equation about the alternating current side power supply electric quantity, the electricity consumption of each charging gun, the inherent loss of a charging station, the energy conversion efficiency of an AC-DC conversion module of each charging pile, equivalent error parameters and the heat loss of each charging gun; acquiring electric quantity data of each charging gun metering point at the alternating current side and the direct current side of the charging station in a plurality of metering periods and energy conversion efficiency of each charging pile; and substituting the electric quantity data and the energy conversion efficiency into an equation to establish an equation set, and solving the equation set to obtain heat loss of each charging gun and equivalent error parameters of each charging gun. The method has the beneficial effects that: on-site verification is not needed, timeliness is high, and online real-time analysis can be achieved.

title: Method for obtaining wide strain rate constitutive relation of material by using single Taylor impact test
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of dynamic mechanical property testing and characterization of materials, and particularly relates to a method for obtaining a wide strain rate constitutive relation of a material by using a single Taylor impact test. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a high-speed image sequence by using a Taylor impact test and full-time-sequence tracking; acquiring an initial velocity field by using a DIC software algorithm; complementing and fitting the initial velocity field by using an extreme random tree model to form a complete high-precision velocity field; obtaining a six-dimensional relation of time, speed, position, stress, strain and strain rate through Lagrange inversion; and slicing the impacted sample at the position of the characteristic strain rate, analyzing the micromechanism of the sample, and constructing a'macroscopic-microcosmic 'quantitative model. By means of the method, the strain rate coverage limitation can be broken through, the wide strain rate gradient covering 102-105 s <-1 > in a single test is achieved, the quantitative incidence relation between macromechanical response and microstructure evolution is established, and finally the thermal viscoplastic constitutive relation based on the microscopic deformation mechanism is established.

title: Method for online verification of oil tank capacity meter
abstract: The invention relates to an oil tank capacity meter on-line verification method, which comprises the following steps: extracting oil tank historical liquid level of a gas station liquid level instrument platform and oiling machine sales flow data, and establishing a corresponding relation between the liquid level height of oil in a gas station oil tank and the volume of oil emitted by an oiling gun; in consideration of indicating value errors and temperature influences of the oil gun, after the volumes of the stored oil and the sold oil are compensated and corrected, the corresponding relation between the height of the oil tank and the accumulated volume is established; and a measurement model is used to realize system fitting, and a new capacity table of a corresponding verification interval with centimeter as an interval is generated. The method has the advantages that the verification standard operation is clear, and the oil tank volume table is automatically generated through the sales flow automatically uploaded by the gas station liquid level instrument platform, temperature compensation and oil gun indication error reduction; the calibration result is prevented from being influenced by uncertain components such as oil volume expansion coefficient, oil metering temperature, liquid level instrument equipment error, oil liquid level fluctuation, oiling machine calibration result uncertainty, oiling machine oil sending temperature and the like.

abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a machine control system (1) having at least one machine controller (3, 3') and at least one mobile handheld operating device (4) which can be carried by an operator. The handheld operating device (4) has at least one operating element (12) or at least one button (13) for an operator to manually influence machine operations. The handheld operating device (4) also comprises a first emergency stop actuation element (8) for terminating potentially dangerous machine operations. The actuation states of the first emergency stop actuation element (8) which are each present and can be manually activated and changed by an operator are transmitted in this case via at least one radio data interface (6, 6') of the handheld operating device (4) using signalling technology and are coupled into an emergency stop safety circuit (9, 9') of a selected or actively connected machine controller (3, 3'). title: Method for operating keystream generators for secure data transmission, said keystream generators being operated in counter mode, keystream generator having counter mode operation for secure data transmission, and computer program product for keystream generation
abstract: The aim of the invention is to protect keystream generators for secure data transmission, said keystream generators being operated in counter mode, against repeated or improper generation of an already generated keystream and to protect the data transmission against repeated use of a keystream, so-called reuse. This aim is achieved, according to the invention, in that the keystream generator (SSG) is operated, with respect to realization options, selectively in one of two operating modes, an encryption operating mode and a decryption operating mode. In the encryption operating mode, a keystream (SSTVS) generated on the basis of a first control data set (SDS1) is used to encrypt data (DT), in particular payload data (NDT), to form cipher-data (CHE), the product of ciphered data or payload data. In the decryption operating mode, a keystream (SSTES) generated on the basis of a second control data set (SDS2) is used to decrypt the cipher-data (CHE). The keystream (SSTVS, SSTES) is output only if the generation of the keystream (SSTVS, SSTES) from the encryption of a counter value of the keystream generator (SSG) operated in counter mode with a block cipher key (BGS) is error-free.

title: Method for paying a fee for allowing a vehicle to use a road network that is subject to toll charges, and toll system for performing the method
abstract: The invention relates to a method and to a toll system for paying a fee for allowing a vehicle (1) to use a road network that is subject to toll charges. A random generator (2) generates a random character string (S) and transmits it to an electronic payment system (2) for handing the fee payment, and to a monitoring device (3) for an on-road check on a usage authorization of vehicles (1) using the road network. A user registers with the payment system (2) in order to acquire a usage authorization and in the process inputs a registration number (K) of the vehicle (1) intended for use. The payment system (2) uses a hash algorithm to generate a hash value (H) from the registration number (K) and the currently valid character string (S) and transmits said hash value to an electronic operator system (4) of a toll operator, which retains the transmitted hash value (H) for monitoring purposes. The monitoring device (3) uses video recordings and video evaluation of a passing vehicle (1) to record a registration number (K) of the vehicle (1) and likewise uses the hash algorithm to generate the hash value (H) from the recorded registration number (K) and the currently valid character string (S), and transmits said hash value to the operator system (4). The operator system (4) checks whether the hash value (H) transmitted by the monitoring device (3) matches a still-retained hash value (H) transmitted by the payment system (2). This enables time-dependent and distance-dependent levying of road usage fees in free-flowing traffic and monitoring of payment thereof, without having to permanently install specialized terminals in the vehicle (1) and while safeguarding the user's privacy.

title: Method for preparing musical instrument lute by using chemical wood composite material
abstract: The invention belongs to a method for preparing a musical instrument lute by using a chemical wood composite material. A back plate is made of a polyurethane material; the back plate made of polyurethane is in an open semi-pear shape, the upper portion of the inner edge of the opening edge of the back plate is provided with a groove for the side edge of the soundboard to be clamped in, the upper end edge of the back plate is provided with a tenon, and the lower end of the headstock clamping rod is connected with the tenon. The thickness and the weight of the back plate are controlled by a back plate mold and the amount of polyurethane; the soundboard, the headstock clamping rod and the sound beam are made of wood. abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method of inspecting the working state of a high pressure descaling nozzle. The method comprises the following steps: sprinkling water to a targeting slab before a targeting experiment for natural rusting; putting the targeting slab in a roller bed by a hoisting tool; when the targeting slab moves into a descaling box, controlling the high pressure descaling nozzle to be started to target the targeting slab; and hoisting the targeted targeting slab out of the roller bed, and judging the working state of the high pressure descaling nozzle according toa rust condition on the targeting slab. title: Methods and systems for computing notional source signatures from near-field measurements and modeled notional signatures.
abstract: Methods and systems for computing notional source signatures from modeled notional signatures and measured near-field signatures are described. Modeled near-field signatures are calculated from the modeled notional signatures. Low weights are assigned to parts of a source pressure wavefield spectrum where signatures are less reliable and higher weights are assigned to parts of the source pressure wavefield spectrum where signatures are more reliable. The part of the spectrum where both sets of signatures are reliable can be used for quality control and for comparing the measured near-field signatures to modeled near-field signatures. When there are uncertainties in the input parameters to the modeling, the input parameters can be scaled to minimize the differences between measured and modeled near-field signatures. Resultant near-field signatures are computed by a weighted summation of the modeled and measured near-field signatures, and notional source signatures are calculated from t he resultant near-field signatures.

title: Methods and systems of digital rights management for integrated circuits
abstract: Methods for remote activation and permanent or temporary deactivation of integrated circuits (IC) for digital rights management are disclosed. Remote activation enables designers to remotely control each IC manufactured by an independent silicon foundry. Certain embodiments of the invention exploit inherent unclonable variability in modern manufacturing for the creation of unique identification (ID) and then integrate the IDs into the circuit functionality. Some of the objectives may be realized by replicating a subset of states of one or more finite state machines and by superimposing additional state transitions that are known only to the designer. On each chip, the added transitions signals are a function of the unique IDs and are thus unclonable. The method and system of the invention is robust against operational and environment conditions, unclonable and attack-resilient, while having a low overhead and a unique key for each IC with very high probability.

title: Multi-layer threshold adjustable socket system that detects standby consumption and automatically closes the mechanical on/off switch
abstract: This invention is an intelligent electrical outlet system developed to prevent energy waste occurring in standby mode of electrical devices. The basic principle of the system is to detect the transition to standby mode by continuously monitoring the current consumption of the connected devices, and in this case to completely cut the energy of the outlet through a physical mechanical switch. The components of the system include the microcontroller, Hall effect based current sensor, servo motor, servo arm, stopper element, DIP switch set, trimmer potentiometer, EEPROM memory module, calibrated indicator dial, ADC module and caliber button. These components work together to monitor the consumption profiles of electrical devices and make appropriate interventions. The distinctive feature of the invention is that it offers a three-layer threshold adjustment mechanism that can adapt to different device types. The first layer is set at the hardware level: with the DIP switch you can choose from sixteen different profiles. These profiles include typical standby current values for different device categories such as television, computer, charger, office equipment. In addition, precise adjustments can be made to the selected profile with the trimmer potentiometer. The instrument dial allows the user to visually follow the current setting level. The second layer runs software-based. The EEPROM memory module stores minimum and maximum threshold values, validation times, hysteresis bands, and security control data for each profile. This layer includes various locks for the system to work safely: minimum threshold lock that blocks very low threshold values, maximum threshold lock that limits extremely high values, and time lock that determines the verification time range. In addition, the anti-lock mechanism detects the vibration states that can keep the system in an open-close loop and automatically solves this problem by increasing the threshold value. The third layer includes intelligent adaptation. When Auto Mode is selected, the system implements a ten-cycle learning process. In the first cycles, the active and standby current values of the connected device are recorded. The average and standard deviation of the standby currents are calculated in the following cycles. Based on these statistical data, an optimal threshold value is determined and recorded on the EEPROM. The system adapts to device aging or changes in environmental conditions by recalculating the threshold value at certain intervals after learning. The microcontroller applies high-frequency samples and digital filtering of analog signals received from the current sensor. The system reacts when the measured current value remains below the specified threshold for a certain period of time and passes hysteresis tape control. The hysteresis mechanism ensures stable operation by preventing vibrations that may occur around the threshold. The servo motor gently applies pressure to the mechanical switch by precise positioning with the PWM signal it receives from the microcontroller. The stopper element prevents excessive positioning by physically determining the movement limits of the servo motor. By placing the mechanical switch in the closed position, the outlet and the energy coming to the control circuit are completely cut off. The microcontroller deactivates the system by cutting its own energy after returning the servo motor to its neutral position. This results in zero standby consumption at the outlet. Since no electronic relay or solid state switch is used, leakage current and leakage current problems are not experienced. Re-opening of the outlet occurs when the user manually turns on the mechanical switch. This one-way automation approach prevents unwanted automatic opening. After manual opening, the system is activated again and begins the standby monitoring cycle. With the Caliber button, users can create a custom profile based on the current current value or reset the system to its factory settings. The system provides energy efficiency through flexible adaptation to different device types, true zero consumption, smart learning and false trigger prevention features.

The novel movable gynecologic irrigator comprises a cart and an intelligent lock, universal wheels are mounted on the lower end surface of the cart, a heating water tank is arranged at the upper end of the cart, a water injection port is formed in the left lower end of the heating water tank, and a water pump is mounted at the right end of the heating water tank. The irrigator is provided with an adjusting knob, water temperature and ejection pressure of the irrigator can be controlled by adjusting the adjusting knob, signals can be transmitted by a patch antenna, use information of a user can be transmitted, the irrigator is regularly cleaned by irradiation of an ultraviolet germicidal lamp and can beused by scanning a use two-dimensional code by a mobile phone, the information of the user can be verified in using, operation of the irrigator of irrelevant personnel is avoided, damage to the irrigator can be timely known, and the irrigator can be timely maintained.

title: Numerically-controlled machine tool electric cabinet reliability test device with environment loading function
abstract: The invention discloses a numerically-controlled machine tool electric cabinet reliability test device with an environment loading function. The numerically-controlled machine tool electric cabinet reliability test device consists of an electric cabinet detection mechanism, a bearing vehicle and an environment loading device, wherein the electric cabinet detection mechanism is fixed on the bearing vehicle; the environment loading device is fixedly arranged on a ground boss. When the electric cabinet is detected, the electric cabinet is put in a second box body and a cabin door is closed to enable the environment loading device to be in a sealed state; according to the actual working conditions required to be simulated, the parameters such as the environment temperature, humidity and environment dust density are set through a computer; the computer is used for controlling, monitoring, storing related test information and detection data and then carrying out sequential detection on the electric cabinet. The numerically-controlled machine tool electric cabinet reliability test device is simple in structure and convenient to operate; through simulating the environment load in the actual working conditions and carrying out performance test and reliability test on the electric cabinet, so that the possibility of electric cabinet failure in the using process of the numerically-controlled machine tool is reduced, the maintenance and repairing cost of the numerically-controlled machine tool is reduced and the reliability of the numerically-controlled machine tool electric cabinet in the using process is improved.

title: Object control using virtual rays
abstract: Techniques for controlling objects include a handheld controller that provides an output to generate virtual rays. The virtual ray has a position and a direction. The location of the virtual ray is measured as the location of the portable controller, based on input from a sensor in the ambient space. When the user moves and/or rotates the portable controller, the virtual rays of light pass through space and intersect various objects. When the virtual light rays intersect the location of the controllable object whose identity and location are known, the portable controller identifies the object and accepts remote control input from the user for object control. With this portable controller, a user can control any controllable object whose identity and position in space are known, and can control virtual and physical objects. Selected Drawing: FIG.1

abstract: The invention discloses an off-line payment method for bidirectional public key system authenticating of visible light and a bar code. An off-line consumption apparatus with bidirectional authenticating of visible light and a bar code is established and consists of an electronic wallet, a consumption machine and a server. The electronic wallet sends a visible light signal and scans a bar code displayed by the consumption machine during the payment process; the consumption machine receives the visible light signal and generates a display bar code that can be scanned by the electronic wallet. abstract: The invention discloses an offline charging method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of oiling machine data transmission, in particular to an oiling machine data security encryption transmission system which comprises a data acquisition unit, a multi-source data association unit, a service rule base, a real-time rule engine and a security routing controller. According to the invention, the core working mechanism of the refueling machine, namely the physical coupling relationship between fluid metering and electromagnetic valve control, and the business causal logic of accumulated oil quantity and transaction state transition, is directly converted into a computable and executable safety verification rule, and the data encryption strength and the transmission path are dynamically regulated and controlled based on the real-time verification result. abstract: An Olive Tree Polyphenol and Lactobacillus Reuteri Compound for Rebalancing Oral Inflammation and Dysbiosis Associated with Consumers who use Tobacco industry products such as nicotine pouches is disclosed. These tobacco products tend to have a propensity to facilitate the colonization of pathogens in oral biofilms leading to negative side effects such as oral mucosal inflammation and dysbiosis. An object of the invention is to develop a composition to mitigate oral inflammation and restore a normal oral, microbial balance. This mixture includes olive polyphenols and Lactobacillus Reuteri. The composition can also be manufactured into various embodiment forms, including but not limited to: an oral spray; an effervescent tablet; a chewable tablet; a capsule; and a powder. title: Operating wellbore tools
abstract: A multiple wellbore tool apparatus consisting of a plurality of microprocessor implemented wellbore tools 26, 20 is disposed in a fluid filled wellbore, and an input stimulus having a predetermined signature propagates 34 down the wellbore fluid to all of the wellbore tools. The plurality of wellbore tools each include a microprocessor implemented controller board 26d, 20d as well as an included wellbore tool 26h, 20h and an acoustic receiver transmitter transducer 26a, 20a connected to an output of the controller board. In addition, each of the microprocessors of each controller board include a memory which stores its own unique microcode programming. In response to the input stimulus sensed by sensor 26b, 20b, the controller board of a first wellbore tool determines that a correspondence exists between the signature of the stimulus and information stored therein and generates an output signal. The output signal may operate the included wellbore tool, or, in response to the output signal, the acoustic transmitter may transmit a first acoustic signal via an acoustic bus 36 which may be either an outer housing of the multiple wellbore tool apparatus, or through the wellbore fluid, to all of the other wellbore tools. In response to the first acoustic signal, the controller board of a second wellbore tool will operate its included wellbore tool. When its operation is complete, that included wellbore tool will transmit a signature confirmation signal back to its controller board indicative of completion of its operation. That controller board will respond by instructing its acoustic transmitter to propagate a second acoustic signal through bus 36. A controller board of a third wellbore tool will respond to the second acoustic signal by operating its included wellbore tool. The above operational sequence is repeated until all of the included wellbore tools of the plurality of wellbore tools of the multiple wellbore tool apparatus are automatically operated in a pre-programmed manner as defined by the microcode programming encoded in the plurality of microprocessors.

title: Operation error monitoring method for direct current charging pile
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of charging piles, and particularly relates to an operation error monitoring method of a direct current charging pile. In order to overcome the defect that an on-site verification system is adopted to detect the operation error of a charging pile at present, the invention adopts the following technical scheme: the operation error monitoring method for the direct current charging pile is provided and comprises the following steps: establishing equations about alternating current side power supply electric quantity, electricity consumption of each charging gun, inherent loss, energy conversion efficiency of an AC-DC conversion module of the charging pile and equivalent operation error parameters according to the law of conservation of energy; acquiring electric quantity data of each charging gun metering point at the alternating current side and the direct current side of the charging pile and charging pile energy conversion efficiency; and substituting the electric quantity data and the energy conversion efficiency into the equations to establish an equation set, and solving the equation set to obtain the inherent loss power consumption of the charging pile and the equivalent operation error parameter of each charging gun. The method has the advantages that on-site verification is not needed, timeliness is high, and online real-time analysis can be achieved.

title: Optical device for measuring the arc height of an intermediate element in relation to the connecting line of two elements located on both sides at the same distance from the intermediate element
abstract: 1,159,139. Surveying instruments. SOC. DES LUNETIERS. Jan.27, 1967 [Feb. 10, 1966], No.4279/67. Heading G1F. An optical instrument for measuring the transverse distance of a first element along an axis X, X1 from a line Y, Y1 between two other elements I, III, comprises a telescope A with prisms E, F to enable the images of the two elements I, III to be superposed, so that the prisms can be aligned on the line Y, Y1, and means (not shown), for measuring the shift of the instrument on the axis X, X1 between this aligned position and the position of the first element. The instrument is described as being of use in measuring the height of arc of a chord used in checking the curvature of railway track. A series of elements as I, m are set up at regular intervals along the track and at a set distance from one rail of the track. The instrument is mounted on a first element intermediate two others in alignment with a vertical pin defining the position of the element. The instrument is then sighted on the vertical pins of the two elements on either side of the first element and the instrument shifted along the line X, X1, e.g. by a rack and pinion mechanism until the two images of the vertical pins are coincident and in alignment with the telescope crosswires. A scale is provided for measuring the shift along the line X, X1 and this gives the required arc height directly.(From GB1159139 A)

title: Parking lock type smart charging pile and using method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of electric automobile charging, and specifically provides a parking lock type smart charging pile and a using method thereof. The parking lock type smart charging pile and the using method thereof aim to solve the problems that in the prior art, the relevance between a charging pile and a parking lock of an electric automobile is poor, and the electric automobile can only be in and out of a parking space in one direction. For the purpose, the smart charging pile comprises a charging pile body, a stop bar, a wireless communication module, an authentication module, and an unlocking control module, wherein the stop bar, the wireless communication module, the authentication module and the unlocking control module are arranged on the charging pile body. The smart charging pile is connected with the electric automobile in a wireless communication mode through the wireless communication module, authenticates the electric automobile through the authentication module, and unlocks the control module to enable the stop bar to convert to a parking place releasing position on the condition that the automobile passes authentication, the electric automobile can be driven into the parking space, and then a charging gun is pulled out to charge the electric automobile. So the smart charging pile can establish wireless communication with the electric automobile and conduct authentication to enable the electric automobile to go into the parking space in any direction.

abstract: A compact, portable bar code scanner employing as a light source a light-emitting diode consumes extremely low input power. The scanner operates with bar code symbols responsive to red light and is of sufficiently low weight to be easily hand-held.

A portable short-wave transmitter-receiver comprises a crystal-controlled oscillator for transmission, and a super-regenerative receiver, the crystal being short-circuited during reception. With the send-receive switches at E the transmitter comprises an oscillator T1 controlled by the crystal 14, followed by a high-frequency amplifier T2. The grid of the modulating valve T3 is connected to a piezo-electric throat microphone 33 and the output from T3 is amplified by the valve T4 and modulates the screen of valve T2. The headset 30 is connected via capacitor 76 to the anode of valve T4 to provide sidetone. With the send-receive switches at R the crystal 14 is short-circuited and the screen grid of T1 disconnected, and the receiver comprises the valve T2 which becomes a high-frequency oscillator interrupted by means of the grid circuit which has a time constant dependent on the resistor 19, inductance 20, and capacitor 21, the inductance 20 preventing the grid from being earthed for highfrequency through the capacitor 21. The aerial 11 is connected to the anode of valve T2 and the detected signal appears across the inductance 23, is amplified by valves T3 and T4, and applied to the headset 30 via transformer 31. In an alternative arrangement, Fig. 7 (not shown), the functions of high-frequency amplifier for transmission and super-regenerative detector for reception are carried out by separate valves. Power is provided by a twovolt accumulator 40, a series resistor 411 dropping the voltage to 1.4 volts for the heaters, and a vibrator 43 providing the H.T. An additional winding on the transformer 44 provides through a rectifier 56 a negative voltage to bias the valve T4. The accumulator can be recharged without removing it from the case by connecting the charger to a coaxial attachment 97 and operating the switch 92. title: Predict the damping time of financial market shocks by natural language processing and reinforcement learning-based multi-agent simulation
abstract: This is an AI system based on Reinforcement Learning and Natural Language Processing that predicts when shocks and panic waves in financial markets will end (Damping Duration). The system simulates how virtual agents are influenced by the verbal sensations (Whispers) they convey to each other in five different behavioral profiles (Oppositional, Quantitative, Skeptical, FOMO, Conservative) that imitate market actors. Unlike existing systems, the invention includes two critical innovations: (i) the Historical Case Scanner automatically widens the past shocks and extends the verification base as an autonomous agent that operates continuously; (ii) the Real-Time Deviation Corrector compares the expected and actual values during the shock process, updating the forecast as a live projection, focusing on asymmetric shadow data in case of deviation. This approach delivers greater accuracy and applicability in financial risk management by providing a projection that is constantly updated instead of a one-time forecast.

The method comprises the following steps: establishing a fire monitor jet motion trail equation, calculating correction parameters of the fire monitor jet motion trail equation by using parameter fitting software according to a fire monitor jet motion trail experimental measurement result, thereby determining the fire monitor jet motion trail equation, and determining the fire monitor jet motion trail according to actual fire-fighting foam jet experimental parameters. And utilizing the fire monitor jet flow motion trail equation to predict the fire monitor jet flow motion trail and verify the accuracy. According to the method, accurate prediction of the foam jet motion trail of the fire monitor is realized, and a more accurate reference basis is provided for making fire-fighting tactics.

title: Preventing unauthorized use of the device
abstract: Unauthorized use of the protected device may only allow operation of the protected device while the enable signal is being generated and may be prevented using customized hardware that prevents that operation at all other times. The enable signal is generated only when fluctuations in the incident ultrasonic wave indicate that the particular ultrasonic activation signal has arrived. This ultrasonic activation signal is generated by an activation unit acoustically coupled within the ultrasonic conductor (, e.g., the human body). Since the ultrasonic activation signal cannot cross the gap, its destination can be reached only when both the activation unit and the protected device maintain acoustic contact with the ultrasonic conductor. Also, the signal actually received by the protected device must be the same specific ultrasonic activation signal that the protected device predicts.

abstract: The invention relates to the field of PCBs, and discloses a quality tracing method for a multi-layer PCB. The method comprises: using two industrial robots (20) in cooperation with a tube-tube sheet welding gun (30) to perform seam welding to weld all tubes within a tube sheet. A route planning and offline programming module plans a collision-free welding route and performs offline programming. A laser scanning and positioning module acquires coordinates of a circle center of a tube aperture to realize identification of an initial welding location and self-guiding. An online quality detection module for a welded seam obtains a three-dimensional reconstruction image according to a laser scanning result of a welded seam, and performs an online quality detection on the welded seam according to the appearance thereof.

title: Role-Based Digital Agriculture Management System Providing AI-Assisted Plant Disease Diagnosis, Expert-Approved Electronic Prescription Flow and Multi-Source Agricultural Data Integration
abstract: Technical field The invention is about end-to-end digitization of agricultural production processes, especially plant disease diagnosis with image-based artificial intelligence, agricultural engineer approval / prescription workflow and Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, remote sensing (satellite / unmanned aerial vehicle), weather and market price data to be combined in a single server-client architecture, a computer-based agriculture management system using role-based authorization. In existing agricultural software, disease diagnosis, expert consultancy, official prescription, monitoring sensor and remote sensing data, market price tracking, income-expense planning and integration with official agricultural systems (FCS, BKU-VT, B-Prescription, TARBIL, DITAP, e-Government) are carried out in separate applications. This fragmented structure brings about (i) the risk of improper drug recommendation due to the use of the preliminary diagnosis result obtained by artificial intelligence without verification by the expert, (ii) the difficulty of physical access to the farmer, (iii) the regulation of the prescription free from the diagnostic data, (iv) the failure to collect field-based historical data (planting, spraying, harmful, soil, sensor, NDVI) in one place and (v) the inability to keep traceable records in accordance with the legislation. Solution Invention is an agricultural management system based on the common data layer on the server, which offers a separate interface and authority set for at least three different roles: farmer, agricultural engineer and administrator (municipality / admin). The system solves the problems mentioned with the integration of the following elements: AI-based image diagnosis module: Analyzes the plant photo uploaded by the farmer and ranks the possible diseases with a confidence score; relates the result to the relevant field and plant record. Expert approval cycle: The diagnostic result is transmitted to an agricultural engineer for verification via the same record; the engineer approves the diagnosis, corrects it, or adds explanation; however, the approved diagnosis can trigger the prescription process. Contextual electronic prescription generation module: Engineer arranges the electronic prescription containing drug, dose, number of applications, waiting and pre-harvest period information based on verified diagnosis, a database of plant protection products and the past disinfection records of the field; the prescription is ready to be transferred to the official B-Prescription flow. Multi-source field data layer: For each field, the crop history, disinfestation record, pest observation, soil analysis, IoT sensor measurements and NDVI/satellite readings are combined under one entity; prescription and diagnostic data are connected to this layer. Decision support modules: Weather data, alerts based on sensor thresholds, harvest forecast and market price monitoring/warning mechanisms provide data on decisions regarding spraying, irrigation and sales timing. Income-expense and product recommendation modules: Revenue estimation based on field size, planted plant and current market price, and seed/fertilizer/medicine expense tracking; Step-by-step product recommendation wizard taking into account crop rotation and soil availability. Formal integration interface: The abstraction integration layer for data exchange with FRS, e-Government, TARBIL, DITAP, BKU-VT, and B-Prescription systems; connection status and last synchronization time are monitored from the management panel. Expert-farmer matchmaking and marketplace: Engineer listing, assignment, and messaging by area of expertise and region; direct ad-based marketplace between producer and buyer. Thanks to this structure, artificial intelligence diagnosis, expert verification and official prescription are produced as a single traceable record chain; diagnosis, prescription, application and harvest data are integrated under the same field object and a regulatory, auditable data flow is provided.

title: Safety lock and flat key for said lock.
abstract: A safety lock and key includes a cylindrical stator and rotor having conventional spring-loaded moving rotor pins and moving stator pins. A first rotor pin/stator pin combination is at substantially 45 degrees to a first face of the key while a second rotor pin/stator pin combination is substantially perpendicular to a second face of the key on the opposite side. The centerlines of the rotor pin/stator pin combinations pass through the center of rotation of the rotor. A housing in the key contains a moving element and emerges from the first face of the key inclined at the same angle as the first rotor pin/stator pin combination. The housing also emerges from the second face of the key through a tapered bore that receives the second rotor pin/stator pin combination. A tapered head of the second rotor pin engages a rear portion of the moving element in the housing, thus engaging the moving element with the first rotor pin/stator pin combination. Inserting the key into the rotor thus moves the rotor pin/stator pin combinations from a locked position to an unlocked position.(From [publication reference] A)

title: Safety system for a power unit
abstract: A safety system for a power unit is disclosed. The safety system includes a detection system configured to detect a dangerous condition between the body and an actuation portion of the machine, such as accidental contact with the actuation portion, and a reaction system coupled to the detection system and configured to cause the machine to take a certain action when the dangerous condition is detected. The sensing system may be configured to capacitively communicate the charge on the actuator and sense as the charge decreases. The reaction system may be a braking system that deactivates the actuator, a retraction system that retracts the actuator, a system that covers the actuator, or other systems. Other features and components of the present safety system are also disclosed. Also disclosed herein are machines equipped with safety systems, such as saws, hand plate boards, and other wood processing machines. title: Secure Multi-Party Communication with Quantum Key Distribution Managed by Communication Trusted Authority
abstract: Techniques and tools for implementing protocols for secure multi-party communication following quantum key delivery ("QKD") are described. In an example implementation, the communication trust facilitates secure communication between the plurality of user devices. The communication trust delivers respective different quantum keys by the QKD under trust relationships with various users. A communication trust seeks a composite key using the quantum key and allows the composite key to be delivered (e.g., non-secret delivery over a public channel). The composite key facilitates secure communication between two user devices even when no QKD occurs between the two user devices. These protocols extend the advantages of QKD to multi-party communication scenarios. These protocols may also retain the advantages of QKD even when communication trust institutions are offline or large groups seek to establish secure communication within the group.

title: Seismic data spectrum restoring and broadening
abstract: A method of spectrum restoring and broadening to produce high resolution seismic data from a plurality of shot records in a seismic survey is described. The method includes the steps of: dividing each shot record into a plurality of windows, in which each of the relevant variables is practically constant, and wherein each window contains one or more trace segments; forward modelling of spectral signatures for any ghost reflections in the shot records using a best estimate of all known parameters, such that every trace segment will have an observed and a (prior) modelled spectral signature; calculating an inverse operator to correct the spectral notches in every trace segment using a constrained set of final fitted values for all the relevant variables; and, recombining the processed trace segments to produce a final set of shot records whereby, in use, the deleterious effects of the ghost reflections in the shot records can be substantially eliminated. Amplitude and phase errors, both within a single shot record and between shots, due to ghost reflections can be corrected.

title: Self-validating Temperature Sensor
abstract: To provide a self-verification temperature sensor and method for measuring and verifying the thermodynamic temperature of a system. The sensor is composed of various combinations such as a temperature dependent element, for example, a thermoelectric element, a resistive element, a capacitor element and other inductor elements. As a preferable example, the sensor is made of a resistance element connected between the four thermoelectric wires, and the fifth thermoelectric element is connected to the resistance element. The sensor generates data signatures from various measurements such as voltage, resistance, inductance, and capacitance. The measuring electronics collect and adjust the data signatures. The computer analyzes its data signature and informs the operator of the verified temperature. This allows on-site recalibration and eliminates the need to remove the sensor for recalibration.

title: Sensitive to user behavior, skin biophysical parameters and time-dependent adaptation processes; adaptive dermal management system that performs functional mapping, passively converts mechanical micro-movements to energy, includes shape memory and discontinuous mechanical network architectures, and compulsorily manages the use of multiple cosmetic products with digital-physical lock mechanisms.
abstract: This invention is related to an integrated dermal management system and a method for the application of this system, which manages the use of cosmetic and dermocosmetic products applied topically to the skin surface depending on the physiological and biophysical condition of the skin and the physical behavior of the user. The system developed within the scope of the invention includes a formulation structure that creates a functional distribution map on the skin depending on physiological and biophysical parameters such as pH, moisture, sebum of the skin surface, the mechanical-sensitive carrier phases that convert the mechanical energy arising from the user's voluntary or involuntary micro-movements, mimic movements, muscle contractions, contact, friction and micro vibrations to the active substance emission rate and / or release density, and a polymeric skeletal network structure that provides passive mechanical support that exhibits non-continuous, microscopic cavities on the skin surface. The system is also configured with a decision and control infrastructure that technically restricts, delays, blocks or stops dosing the use of such formulation according to the content compatibility between products, chemical and / or functional conflict criteria for the combined or consecutive use of multiple products. This infrastructure may consist of digital, electronic, mechanical or their functional equivalents and ensures that product usage is managed not only at the informational level but also technically. In the method dimension of the invention, it is ensured that the biophysical condition of the skin is passively mapped without the need for any active measurement, sensor or external sensor, dynamic and regional dosing is applied in the areas determined on the skin based on this mapping depending on the user's physical activity level, micro-movement intensity and frequency of mimic use, and the effect profile of the system automatically evolves from a high-impact attack phase to a more stable balance phase in line with the biophysical response of the skin to the product during the usage process. This process is verified and validated by a central inspection and control unit via the NFC, QR code or their functional equivalents on the product. Thanks to this structure, the sequence, duration, combination and impact profile related to product use are technically controlled based on skin condition and usage behavior, without leaving it to the user's preference. In this respect, the invention offers a dermal management solution that combines active substance emission, mechanical behavior, functional distribution, multiple product interactions and usage process within a holistic system architecture, can be applied within the limits of cosmetic legislation, can be produced on an industrial scale and compatible with regulation.

title: Spray gun blockage detecting method for blast furnace coal injection system
abstract: The invention relates to a spray gun blockage detecting method for a blast furnace coal injection system, which is used for polling detection of all spray guns in the blast furnace coal injection system, and comprises the following steps: cutting a coal injection branch connected to a current spray gun; detecting whether the total injection flow rate of the blast furnace coal injection system is changed or not; if yes, connecting the coal injection branch to the current spray gun again, while if not, keeping the coal injection branch to be separated from the current spray gun; and determining spray guns which are separated from corresponding coal injection branches are blocked spray guns. According to the polling detection method, all the coal injection branches connected to the spray guns are cut off, and whether the total injection flow rate of the blast furnace coal injection system is changed or not is judged, so as to judge whether the spray guns are blocked by injection materials in pipelines or not. abstract: The invention discloses a spraying robot trajectory planning method based on depth camera scanning. According to the method, the problem that global coverage and local thickness uniformity cannot be considered in traditional geometric planning is solved, and high-quality full-automatic spraying is achieved.

abstract: The present invention relates to a recyclable charity wreath order system and a method thereof capable of legally using a wreath again. abstract: A system to alleviate the burden that elderly non-hospital patients face with drug compliance is exposed. Preferred embodiments of the invention provide advantages for handling error-prone tasks. The system includes an integrated dispensing device with remote medical monitoring. The dispensing device is placed in communication with a monitoring station, where the transmitted data is processed by a server and stored in a database. Online accessible configuration panels are provided to patients and healthcare professionals for safe implementation in the dispensing device of medical programs, reminders, alarms and personalized messages, even in response to triggering events. The configuration panels accessible online can also allow you to manage plans for drug refills and medical visits. In addition, the dispensing device can be loaded with planned doses prepared and packaged under the supervision of pharmacists, and home delivery can also be included. Another form of control for safe drug distribution can be implemented through a process of recognizing the drugs that are released. In addition, the dispensing device is configured to collect physiological data, available with compliance profiles from configuration panels accessible online. The advantage is that healthcare professionals are in a position to verify treatments and prevent emergencies with timely interventions. The dispensing device is also expected to be equipped with a touch screen to simplify communication between patients and healthcare professionals. Personalized investigations can be initiated by patients to request medical assistance and refine it. In this way, patients can further improve their ability to manage the disease.

abstract: The present invention belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle battery management and testing. The method comprises: when verification request data has been received, in response to an SOC precision verification instruction, respectively sending corresponding working condition parameters to a drum, an environmental chamber and a charging device according to a corresponding test working condition; respectively acquiring current data of a traction battery, and real vehicle data; obtaining reference SOC data according to the current data of the traction battery; and performing SOC precision verification during a vehicle operation process according to the reference SOC data and the real vehicle data, and obtaining a corresponding working condition test result. In the present invention, SOC hopping is identified by means of big data, a usage working condition of a user is extracted, the composition of the working condition of the user is analyzed, a test working condition is obtained by means of performing fitting according to an analysis result, the test working condition is simulated by means of a test apparatus, and the SOC precision is then verified, such that the test working condition can be close to the usage working condition of the user, thereby improving the test coverage degree, and improving SOC precision verification.

title: Systems and methods with identity verification by comparison and interpretation of skin patterns such as fingerprints
abstract: A sensor receives a print image from an authorized person (21) to form a template, and from a candidate (11) to form test data. Noise variance (12) is estimated from the test data as a function of position in the image, and used to weight the importance of comparison with the template at each position. Test data are multilevel, and are bandpassed and normalized (13) and expressed as local sinusoids for comparison. A ridge spacing and direction map (28) of the template is stored as vector wavenumber fields, which are later used to refine comparison. Global dilation (34) and also differential distortions (45) of the test image are estimated, and taken into account in the comparison. Comparison yields a test statistic (52) that is the ratio, or log of the ratio, of the likelihoods of obtaining the test image assuming that it respectively was, and was not, formed by an authorized user. The test statistic is compared with a threshold value, preselected for a desired level of certainty, to make the verification decision.

title: Systems, methods and applications for using and enhancing vehicle to vehicle communications including synergies and interoperation with satellite radio
abstract: Various applications, systems and methods for using, and enhancing V2V communications for various purposes are described. These systems and methods leverage various aspects of satellite radio broadcasts in combination with V2V communications. In some embodiments, V2V-enabled vehicles can receive advertisements or offers from RSEs, or even other V2V enabled vehicles, in a defined Target Region, which may then be played to a user in-vehicle once a given Trigger Region has been entered. By logging all advertisements or offers played to a user and sending the log to an RSE, for example, and from there to a content provider (e.g., an SDARS service operator), verified delivery of advertisements is achieved, which allows the content provider to obtain significant revenues from advertisers. In return for uploading the playback record from the vehicle to the RSE, a variety of incentives may be offered, such as (i) free or discounted satellite radio subscription; (ii) download credits for music or videos from an online store; (iii) reduced or free tolls on toll roads (e.g., RSE embedded in a toll collection plaza); (iv) premium audio or video content, (v) credit at an online store; and (vi) a special coupon code redeemable for merchandise.

title: Tamper-proof over-speed recording system for interceptor vehicles
abstract: The present invention (100) relates to a tamper-proof over-speed recording system for interceptor vehicles (201) employing a secure software system (106) on an embedded computing device (104) interfaced with external speed detection devices (102). It uniquely integrates cryptographic hashing (3) with nonce (4) inclusion to prevent replay attacks and digital signing (5) using keys secured in a tamperresistant hardware security module (200) to guarantee data authenticity and nonrepudiation. The system immutably stores signed data (5a) in Write-Once-Read- Many (210) or permissioned blockchain ledger storage (220), forming a cryptographically linked audit trail. A digital monitoring module (300) securely transmits evidence to a centralized server (400) for signature validation and automated traffic violation processing. Multi-factor authentication and role-based access control restrict system access, and cryptographically protected audit logs ensure full forensic traceability. The invention addresses vulnerabilities in prior art by ensuring immutable, legally admissible evidence of over-speed violations with real-time supervisory oversight.

title: Telematics system for preventive maintenance, driver performance analysis and operation management by collecting multiple data sources from vehicles
abstract: The invention system is an integrated telematics system that combines data from electronic control units of land vehicles, the global positioning system and optional environmental sensors, and processes and evaluates this data in real time. A hardware platform in the in-vehicle control unit collects CAN BUS parameters such as engine speed, vehicle speed, mileage, engine temperature, fuel level, fuel consumption, battery voltage, torque and oil pressure, obtains instant location, speed and route information through the GPS module, receives additional information such as temperature, humidity, load and cover status through optional sensors. The collected data is securely transferred to the central server via event-based dynamic data transmission after time synchronization and filtering by the built-in microprocessor; in cases where there is no connection, the data is stored in the local memory and fully synchronized when the connection is re-established. On the server side, with the statistical analyzes and machine learning algorithms carried out on a cloud-based infrastructure, maintenance need predictions, driver behavior scores and fault detection reports are produced both throughout each vehicle and fleet. The system transmits high-frequency data in case of exceeding critical thresholds with event-based warning mechanisms; and reduces network costs by using low bandwidth under normal conditions. Thanks to its modular hardware architecture, it can be installed in different brands and models of vehicles without intervention and can be expanded with additional sensors. Users can monitor instant data, view past performance analyses and download generated reports via the web-based control panel. In this way, the system offers a comprehensive management and decision support solution for land vehicle fleets in order to increase fuel efficiency, reduce maintenance costs, improve driver performance and ensure operational continuity.

title: Thermal INSULATION
abstract: A thermal insulation composite includes at least a first metallic skin sheet, and a plurality of non-combustible metallic filaments randomly interlocked to form a wool and affixed to said first skin sheet. A second metallic skin sheet may be affixed to said wool and said first sheet, or the second skin sheet may be a surface of the structure to be insulated. A fluid is present in the interstices of the filaments and in the zone between the skin sheets. Each of the filaments has a significant length to cross-sectional diameter ratio to minimize its thermal conductivity. The filaments also preferably have a circular cross section to minimize the area of contact and hence the heat conducted between adjacent filaments. In this manner, the conductivity of the wool is made primarily dependent upon the thermal conductivity of the fluid in the interstices of the filaments. Heat transmission by radiation is inhibited by providing a plurality of radiation shields interposed between multiple layers of the wool. The skin sheets, wool, and radiation shields are bonded by stitches or staples to form an insulation blanket. The interstices of the filaments are of many different sizes so that the insulation has characteristics for absorbing sound waves over a significant band of frequencies. The composite may be used to insulate ducts, airfoil surfaces, fire walls and to form fireproof garments, and has the unique capability of being fabricated into a variety of structural shapes.(From [publication reference] A)

title: Time-division multiplex electronic automatic private branch exchange
abstract: 1449063 TDM PABX CHESTEL Inc 5 Sept 1973 [10 Oct 1972] 41783/73 Heading H4K In a TDM PABX in which an auxiliary conductor pair 22, 32, 25, Fig. 1, distributes clock pulses and wherein telephone sets 34, an attendant's position 27, trunk circuits 36 and single direction devices such as paging loudspeakers and bells are connected to a communication conductor pair 21, 30, 26 by appropriate interfaces in appliques 33, the send and receive legs of the two-way applique circuits are connected to spaced points on the communication conductor, sending being allocated a particular time slot in a frame the occurrance of which is determined by a counter 133, Fig. 8c, at the applique, and the receivers having all of the time slots applied to them to be available for controlled selective reception. Regenerators 40 are spaced along the transmission line. Frames of timing pulses (54 in the embodiment) are transmitted including fifty slots for the respective senders, two supervisory and signalling slots, and two synchronizing slots. The use of most forms of pulse modulation are said to be possible and pulse-width modulation is used in the embodiment. All stations are periodically addressed, bits of the address being transmitted in successive frames in the S and S slots of the communication conductor, and the state of an addressed channel is added at the station to the address code, for reception by any of the stations. Appliques may be arranged to be directly accessed or may be accessed only in conjunction with a transistor message. A fresh address is transmitted from the control station when the idle condition at the end of a composite S and S message is detected. Paging and ringing calls may be captured by a paged applique to establish a normal communication in response to the paging or ringing, and calls to a busy applique may be forwarded either to another predetermined station or to any free direct access station. The stations may be assigned priority classes which are indicated in their messages, and the classification may be used by an operator at the attendant position. Messages which may be either of general interest, or of pertinence to a particular station are successively applied to the S and S channel by a translator 43, and in the case of messages to particular stations, may include a trunk barring indication, or call forwarding instructions. These translator messages when returned to the central station may be used to monitor the appliques for malfunction. A message scheduler 46 which, by means of an address generator 41 sequentially initiates calls, may also connect a message from an applique received by receiver 51 to the pages by way of page transmitter 45. A message for paging being inserted by an applique into its signalling and supervision message. Appliques each use a standard master control unit 86 and have a feature selection unit 88 into which modules may be plugged for determining the features to be provided at that station, and its address. Incoming binary supervisory and control signals received from the communication line are distributed by 178 to master control unit 86 and to message assembler 170 the distributor having its own address supplied and sending a message send command to output or send mesage from the send message assembler 170, outgoing signalling and supervisory messages being generated in the master controller. Communication signals for the receiver are extracted at 92 and converted to voice signals by summing pulse width demodulator 95, under the control of audio gate 96 which selects the desired time slot or slots and may thus provide a conference facility. Audio gate 96 is controlled by a recirculating register 100 to gate the corresponding slot in successive frames in accordance with an address or number supplied over line 104 from the master controller and the occurrence of a corresponding frame count in counter 102. Outgoing signals on audio send line 85 are keyed in the appropriate time slot by audio gate 136 by the output of a digital comparator 133 in which the current timing pulse count of counter 33 is compared with the applique-address as determined by the module in the selection unit 88, and when inputs appear at both inputs of bit gate 142, a binary digital pulse is injected in the current time slot by bit generator 147. The applique master control unit 86 includes a memory 150 comprising six, fifty-bit registers and a register processor. Three of the registers are referred to as "call" registers and are designated "active" ,"camp-on" and "reserve" and in each of these one of the bit positions will be exclusively assigned by a "1" mark to another applique. The states of the other appliques indicated by their S and S messages are stored in another two of the registers and a final register comprises a disconnect signal store. The master control unit includes a hook status detector 124 which affects the call access to the three call registers, and a dial entry processor which delivers signals to the audio unit tone generator, e.g. dialling tone, busy tone, &c., and supplies to outgoing call processor 164 destination signals for a required call, and request signals for break-in or camp-on, the effectiveness of these being determined by plugged in modules in the feature selection unit. Trunk appliques are similar to other appliques but offer no "dial in" facility and give a caller access to a sequence of three call destinations the first of which may be the attendant's station if present, or a zone ringer. Access is not acknowledged to a calling exchange until a completed call is established. The applique includes an outpulser which sends dialling pulses in response to an applique call or in response to an S and S requirement and may further include a dial tone detector which suppresses audio transmission until outpulsing is completed, and circuitry for restricting predetermined out pulsing sequences. The trunk applique may also include a repertory dialler. The facilities provided and the steps necessary for their achievement are described with reference to flow diagrams.(From GB1449063 A)

title: Universal information verification, security and behavior scoring system and method based on artificial intelligence supported, multilayered signal fusion
abstract: This invention relates to a universal information validation, security, and behavior scoring system that combines artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms, probability models, and distributed recording technologies (DLT). The system works as a layer of Validation, Security, and Scoring Orchestration (VSSO), coordinating heterogeneous signals to produce a timely consistent, conditional, unified trust score. The system checks the accuracy, reliability and behavioral integrity of data from different sources, including large language models (LLM), sensor data, VR/AR content, robotic systems, and biological implants. The invention is based on a verification engine that combines multilayered evidence signals (AI analysis, databases, human approval, device integrity, content origin, temporal and conditional integrity) into a single mathematical function called the Universal Verification Function (UVF). This function processes the (Pk) parameters that increase and decrease reliability in a logit-sigmoid-based structure, generating subscores: Accuracy, Safety, and Behavior, and a unified Universal Trust Score (UTS?) Collected under Universal Trust Score. The system also includes a Universal Time Validation Layer (UTVL) that verifies the temporal integrity of events with data from reliable time sources (GPS, NTP, atomic clock) and a Motion Condition Compatibility Module (HKU-M) that analyzes the possibility of an event under physical, financial and legal conditions. All outputs are cryptographically signed and stored on DLT in a portable capsule that complies with the W3C Verifiable Credential standard or equivalent technology standards that may arise in the future. The system functions as a layer of reliability in different industries and securely delivers the validation output to third-party applications.
