title: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster attack task planning method based on hierarchical fusion framework
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster attack task planning method based on a hierarchical fusion framework. The method comprises the following steps: 1, importing unmanned aerial vehicle attack task scene information; 2, dividing the task targets into a plurality of task groups based on a K-means + + algorithm according to the position information of the striking targets; 3, assigning a task to each unmanned aerial vehicle based on a distributed parallel genetic algorithm, and distributing the unmanned aerial vehicle corresponding to each task target into a task group to which the task target belongs; 4, constructing a multi-agent reinforcement learning model, and regarding each unmanned aerial vehicle as an agent; 5, performing multi-agent reinforcement learning network training; and 6, repeating the step 5, and carrying out multiple rounds of confrontation between the red unmanned aerial vehicle and the blue unmanned aerial vehicle. Aiming at the problem of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster attack task planning in a complex battlefield environment, an efficient attack task planning model is constructed in combination with constraint conditions of unmanned aerial vehicle combat, and the pitch angle and the yaw angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each step are finally output, so that full-process planning simulation is realized.

According to the method, the air combat scene of the unmanned aerial vehicle is simulated through a simulation means, algorithm evolution is promoted by adopting a mode of parallel simulation nodes, and multi-round iterative training of the algorithm is realized.

title: Valve structure suitable for liquefied gas steel cylinder intelligent control
abstract: The invention provides a valve structure suitable for liquefied gas steel cylinder intelligent control, relating to the technical field of liquefied gas steel cylinder valves. The valve structure overcomes the defects of poor safety and insufficient reliability in the existing liquefied gas steel cylinder intelligent valve. The valve structure comprises a valve main body, wherein a gas inlet/outlet channel is arranged in the valve main body; and the valve main body is provided with a main valve mechanism for controlling the opening or closing of the gas inlet/outlet channel. The valve structure is characterized in that a normally open one-way valve for preventing invalid gas filling is arranged in the gas inlet/outlet channel; the valve main body is also provided with a solenoid valve for preventing the motion of the normally open one-way valve in case of invalid gas filling; and the solenoid valve is electrically connected with a control module. After the identity authentication is passed, the normally open one-way valve is locked by the solenoid valve, and a gas-filling device starts filling gas into the liquefied gas steel cylinder; and when the identity authentication is not passed, the solenoid valve does not work, and the normally open one-way valve is closed under the action of pressure difference, thereby achieving the goal of restricting gas filling. The valve structure has the advantages of simple and reliable structure and low cost.

title: Vault with controllable data transfer capabilities
abstract: [Problem] To provide a vault capable of protecting electronic data stored within the vault from unauthorized access while enabling convenient data access to authorized users and a system capable of transferring device data from an external data source to a device located within the vault without exposing a concealed location of the vault. Resolution Means. a vault is provided that includes a vault controller coupled to a data transfer port. The vault controller is configured to selectively enable device data to pass through the data transfer port when the valid code is received by the vault controller. Also provided is a system for controlling data communication with an internal device located in a vault. The system includes an external computer configured to execute a set of instructions and a vault. The vault includes a data transfer port coupled to an external computer and an internal device. The vault also includes a vault controller coupled to the data transfer port, where the vault controller is configured to selectively enable communication between the external computer and the internal device when the valid code is received by the vault controller. title: Water-cooling and air-cooling heat dissipation protection device for charging pile
abstract: The utility model discloses a water-cooling and air-cooling heat dissipation protection device for a charging pile, and belongs to the technical field of heat dissipation protection. When a circuit board in a cabinet body is subjected to heat dissipation, a circulating pump fills a heat-conducting medium on one side into a refrigeration box on the other side, so that the heat-conducting medium enters a turnover box; in the process of pushing the heat-conducting medium into the turnover box, the heat-conducting medium makes contact with the first paddles and can drive the first paddles to rotate, the first paddles drive the flow deflectors to rotate through the connecting shafts, in the process that the flow deflectors rotate in the cabinet body, high-temperature gas in the cabinet body generates liquidity, and the heat-conducting medium is pushed into the turnover box. In the rotating process of the flow deflectors, the heat exchange effect of the flow deflectors can be enhanced, heat can be transmitted into the heat-conducting medium through the flow deflectors, the connecting shaft and the first paddles, and then the heat is discharged out of the cabinet body through circular flowing of the heat-conducting medium, so that a passive heat conduction mode is abandoned through an active heat dissipation mode, the heat dissipation effect on the cabinet body is greatly enhanced, and the service life of the cabinet body is prolonged. And normal charging work of the circuit board in the cabinet body is prevented from being affected by over-temperature.

title: Wireless communication auxiliary system for supporting location tracing of firefighters
abstract: The present invention relates to a wireless communication assistant system comprising: a tag worn on a body of a fire fighter and transmitting a tag signal including first identification information of the tag to the outside; a plurality of line repeaters installed on each floor above or below the inside of a building and receiving a downward fire signal from the outside to process the received signal and then transmit the received signal to a first fire fighter, or receiving an upward fire signal from the first fire fighter to process the received signal and then transmit the received signal to the outside, and receiving the tag signal from the tag to process the received signal and then transmit the received signal to the outside, and processing a line repeater signal including second identification information of the tag and then transmit the processed signal to the outside; and a main repeater installed in a situation room or a disaster prevention room for managing firefighting activities, receiving the downward fire signal from a second fire fighter to process the received signal and then transmit the processed signal to the line repeater, or receiving the upward fire signal from the line repeater to process the received signal and then transmit the received signal to the second fire fighter, receiving the tag signal from the line repeater to extract the first identification information, receiving the line repeater signal from the line repeater to extract the second identification information, and calculating a position of the fire fighter using the extracted first and second identification information. title: Wireless visitor information collection terminal
abstract: The utility model discloses a wireless visitor information collection terminal. The wireless visitor information collection terminal comprises a main board, a battery, a hard disk, an operation side display, a client side display, a keyboard, an IC card reader, an identity card reader and a printer. The main board comprises a SIM card slot used for containing a SIM card, an SD card slot used for containing an SD card, a power interface used for being connected with an external power supply and a plurality of peripheral interfaces connected with peripheral equipment. The battery is connected with the main board so as to provide electric energy. The hard disk is connected with the main board and used for storing visitor information. The operation side display is connected with the main board and used for displaying all input information or read information to an operator. The client side display is connected with the operation side display and used for displaying content related to the visitor information to a visitor for confirmation. The keyboard is connected with the displays and used for inputting the visitor information. The IC card reader is connected with the displays and used for acquiring IC card information in a contact mode. The identity card reader is connected with the hard disk and used for recognizing and reading 2nd-generation identity card information of the visitor in a non-contact mode. The printer is connected with the operation side display and used for achieving printing.

title: Working method and system of bluetooth card
abstract: The invention discloses a working method and system of a bluetooth card. The working method comprises: S1, POS terminal sends information to a bluetooth card; S2, the bluetooth card receives information, generates authentication information, and feeds back the authentication information to the POS terminal; and S3, the POS terminal obtains the authentication information. According to the invention, when a user carries out card-needed payment by using the bluetooth card, the user does not need to give the card to a cashier worker for card swiping, so that a phenomenon that the cashier worker copies the card of the user can be avoided and thus the funds security of the card of the user can be guaranteed. Meanwhile, because information exchange with the POS terminal is carried out by the bluetooth, a phenomenon that the card fails to be swiped because of no wireless network can be avoided and thus the card using experience of the user can be improved.

title: Workpiece self-adaptive welding method, medium and equipment
abstract: According to the workpiece self-adaptive welding method, medium and equipment, the condition number of the mechanical arm jacobian matrix under each prediction configuration is calculated, the minimum collision distance between the robot prediction envelope and the tool clamp point cloud is obtained, whether the condition number of the mechanical arm jacobian matrix is smaller than a condition number threshold value or not and whether the minimum collision distance is smaller than a set safety threshold value or not are judged, if not, the angle increment of each joint of the mechanical arm is solved to correct the corresponding mechanical arm joint vector, the current welding seam position is welded, and if not, the mechanical arm external shaft speed and the mechanical arm joint speed are obtained to correct the mechanical arm external shaft vector and the mechanical arm joint vector, and the current welding seam position is welded. The problems that the prior art cannot realize real-time cooperative control of a visual sensor, a robot and a positioner, so that the thermal deformation in the welding process is effectively realized, the welding quality and the production efficiency are improved and the like are solved.
